Treten Sie einem wachsenden internationalen Unternehmen bei, in dem Ihre technische Expertise jeden Tag zur Zuverlässigkeit und Leistung unserer Anlagen beiträgt. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unserem Team in der Abteilung Materials Management suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Storage Technician Production Supply (a) 100% im Schichtbetrieb.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Termingerechte Versorgung der Produktionslinien mit technischen Materialien, Anlagen, Rohstoffen, Halb- und Fertigwaren

• Durchführung der Kommissionierung von chemischen und technischen Materialien

• Ordnungsgemässe Ver- und Entsorgung von Leergebinden

• Mitwirkung beim Abfallhandling inkl. Sortierung und Bereitstellung zur fachgerechten Entsorgung

• Bedienung von Flurförderzeugen und Transportmitteln

• Durchführung von Buchungen im ERP-System SAP und Dokumentation von Materialbewegungen

• Einhaltung von Arbeits-, Umwelt- und Sicherheitsvorschriften, insbesondere beim Umgang mit Gefahrenstoffen

• Unterstützung bei kontinuierlicher Verbesserung von Prozessen (KVP, Lean)

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Bereich Logistik, Chemie, Produktion oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Erfahrung in der Materialversorgung, innerbetrieblichen Logistik oder Kommissionierung

• Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Gefahrstoffen und Arbeitssicherheit von Vorteil

• Staplerführerschein oder Erfahrung im Umgang mit Flurförderzeugen wünschenswert

• Grundkenntnisse in ERP-Systemen SAP

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im Schichtmodell: 3 Frühschichten / 3 Spätschichten / 3 freie Tage

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse

Unser Angebot:

• Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

• Firmeninterne KITA auf dem Bachem Campus Bubendorf

• 60%-ige Übernahme der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem AG sowie Möglichkeit für überobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Wahlsparplan

jobs.description: Für unsere Wirkstoffproduktion suchen wir zur Verstärkung unserer Organisation TechOps in der Abteilung Manufacturing & Process Technology (MPT) per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung einen Chemieingenieur/in oder Verfahrenstechniker/in als Senior Process Specialist (a) in der Fachgruppe Lyophilisation, Sprühtrocknung und Reinraum. Ihre Aufgaben • Verfahrenstechnische Betreuung von Anlagenprojekten • Evaluieren, Entwickeln und Einführen neuer Anlagen und Technologien • Koordination der Qualifizierung und Validierung neuer Anlagen • Teilprojektprojektleitung grosser und Projektleitung kleiner Investitionsprojekte • Optimierung bestehender Produktionsverfahren (durch z.B. verfahrenstechnische, Automations- oder PAT-Lösungen) Ihr Profil • Für diese Position suchen wir eine flexible, durchsetzungsstarke und teamfähige Persönlichkeit • Sie arbeiten proaktiv und strukturiert, sind belastbar und zuverlässig • Sie verfügen über einen Bachelor / Master Abschluss in Chemieingenieurwesen, Verfahrenstechnik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung • Sie bringen mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit und haben Kenntnisse in GMP, Anlagen- und Rohrleitungsbau, Maschinentechnik sowie Arbeitssicherheit und Explosionsschutz • SAP-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil • Kenntnisse in Lyophilisation sind von Vorteil • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1 oder Muttersprache), Grundkenntnisse in Englisch (B2) sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit MS-Office setzen wir voraus. jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Stärkung unseres Routine Teams in der QC Raw & Startings suchen wir Talente als  Lab Technician QC Raw & Startings (a) - 10 0 %,  die Freude an abwechslungsreichen Aufgabenstellungen finden und bei abteilungsübergreifenden Projekten mitwirken .

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Eigenständige Durchführung und Bewertung analytischer Aufträge mit Fokus auf chromatographische Methoden (HPLC, GC, IC)

• Bearbeitung von Freigabe- und Stabilitätsanalysen sowie analytischen Serviceaufträgen

• Aktive Mitwirkung bei Methodenentwicklung, -validierung und -transfer

• Systematisches Troubleshooting bei analytischen Fragestellungen

• Erstellung, Prüfung und Dokumentation von QC-Daten unter strikter Einhaltung von cGMP-Anforderungen

• Unterstützung bei der Untersuchung von OOX-Ergebnissen

• Sicherstellung der Laborabläufe unter konsequenter Einhaltung von GMP, Arbeitssicherheit und Umweltvorgaben

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemielaborant/in mit Schwerpunkt Analytik

• Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung (mind. 2 Jahre) in der chromatographischen Analytik (HPLC, GC, IC) in einem regulierten Umfeld

• GMP-Erfahrung sowie routinierter Umgang mit GMP-Dokumentation und Datenintegrität

• Sehr präzise, strukturierte und qualitätsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit zur selbstständigen Problemlösung im analytischen Alltag

• Teamorientierte, zuverlässige und engagierte Persönlichkeit mit hoher Eigeninitiative

• Erfahrung mit GMP-relevanten IT-Systemen und Chromatographiedatensystemen

• Fliessende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

• Erfahrung in der Pharma-, Life-Science- oder chemischen Industrie wünschenswert

• Kenntnisse in der Analytik von Peptiden und/oder Oligonukleotiden von Vorteil

Unser Angebot:

• Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung mit Möglichkeit für Home-Office und Option zum Bezug zusätzlicher Ferientage

I vostri compiti: Applicazione indipendente e valutazione degli ordini analitici con focus sui metodi cromatografici (HPLC, GC, IC) Elaborazione di analisi di approvazione e stabilità e ordini di servizio analitici Partecipazione attiva allo sviluppo, alla convalida e al trasferimento dei metodi Risoluzione dei problemi sistemici nelle domande analitiche Creazione, sperimentazione e documentazione dei dati QC in stretta conformità con cGMP
• Requisiti Supporto per risultati OOX Assicurare le operazioni di laboratorio in conformità con GMP, sicurezza sul lavoro e requisiti ambientali Il tuo profilo: Formazione completa come laboratorio chimico con focus sull'analisi Esperienza pratica pluriennale (almeno 2 anni) nell'analisi cromatografica (HPLC, GC, IC) in un ambiente regolamentato Esperienza GMP e gestione ordinaria della documentazione GMP e dell'integrità dei dati Funzionamento molto preciso, strutturato e orientato alla qualità Capacità di risolvere il problema in modo indipendente nell'analisi quotidiana Personalità orientata al team, affidabile e impegnata con alta auto-iniziativa Esperienza con sistemi IT e sistemi dati cromatografici GMP-relevant Tedesco e buone competenze in inglese Esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica, life science o chimica desiderabile Conoscenza dell'analisi dei peptidi e/o oligonucleotidi di vantaggio La nostra offerta: Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in crescita con possibilità di sviluppo interne Design flessibile del tempo di lavoro con opzione per l'ufficio di casa e l'opzione per giorni di vacanza aggiuntivi Sostenere i dipendenti attraverso numerose opportunità di formazione interna ed esterna Il 60% dei contributi dei fondi pensione da parte di Bachem AG e la possibilità di un'offerta sovraobbligatoria con il nostro piano di risparmio elettorale Accesso alla piattaforma di vantaggio Swibeco con sconti da partner esterni Cibo fresco, sano e vario nel nostro ristorante personale Varie attività sportive gratuite sul campus di Bachem Vuoi guidare l'innovazione insieme a noi? Abbiamo risvegliato il vostro interesse? Quindi non vediamo l'ora che i vostri documenti applicativi completi tramite il nostro portale di applicazioni. descriptionByLocale.en:
To advance our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our routine team at QC Raw & Startings, we are looking for talents as Lab Technician QC Raw & Startings - 10 0 %, to find the pleasure of diverse tasks and to participate in cross-departmental projects. Your tasks: Independent implementation and evaluation of analytical orders with focus on chromatographic methods (HPLC, GC, IC) Processing of approval and stability analyses and analytical service orders Active participation in method development, validation and transfer Systematic Troubleshooting in Analytical Questions Creation, testing and documentation of QC data in strict compliance with cGMP
• Requirements Support for OOX results Ensuring laboratory operations with consistent compliance with GMP, occupational safety and environmental requirements Your profile: Completed training as a chemical laboratory with focus on analytics Multiannual practical experience (at least 2 years) in chromatographic analysis (HPLC, GC, IC) in a regulated environment GMP experience as well as routined handling of GMP documentation and data integrity Very precise, structured and quality-oriented operation Impressed ability to solve the problem independently in everyday analytics Team-oriented, reliable and committed personality with high self-initiative Experience with GMP-relevant IT systems and chromatography data systems German and good English skills Experience in the pharmaceutical, life science or chemical industry desirable Knowledge of the analysis of peptides and/or oligonucleotides of advantage Our offer: A dynamic and growing working environment with internal further development possibilities Flexible working time design with option for home office and option for additional holiday days Supporting employees through numerous internal and external training opportunities 60% takeover of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG and possibility of overcompulsory provision with our electoral savings plan Access to the advantage platform Swibeco with discounts from external partners Fresh, healthy and varied food in our personal restaurant Various free sports activities on the Bachem Campus Do you want to drive innovation together with us? Did we awaken your interest? Then we look forward to your complete application documents via our application portal. descriptionByLocale.en: In order to drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. descriptionByLocale.en:

To strengthen our active ingredient pilot department, we are looking for a motivated laboratory technician (f/m/d) 100%. In our production facility you produce pharmaceutically effective oligonucleotides and related substances. You work under GMP conditions and use modern production systems from production to purification. Through the practice-oriented training, you will gain the necessary confidence to work independently and responsibly on our production systems and become part of our team. If it is important to you to work with us beyond your daily work to continually improve our production facilities and work processes and you value the opportunity to help shape your working conditions in this way, then you have come to the right place.
• Your tasks: You control and monitor our manufacturing processes at the interface to R&D. You document in accordance with GMP and check the batch documentation. They help qualify the production equipment. You prepare in-process controls and samples and sometimes carry them out yourself. Together with the responsible group leaders, you make decisions for the further course of production, for example based on in-process controls. You carry out cleaning and maintenance work as well as simple repair work on the production systems. They are preparing manufacturing campaigns. To do this, you provide equipment, solvents and raw materials in the respective production rooms and check the equipment and systems. You will work actively and independently on the constant improvement of our production facilities and work processes.
• Your profile: Completed training as a chemical laboratory technician, chemical technician or equivalent training or chemical and pharmaceutical technologist. Flexibility, communication and willingness to learn are among your strengths. Preference for working and documenting according to GMP specifications as well as experience in a GMP environment is an advantage. You are characterized by a high level of reliability, independence and ability to work in a team. You are interested in technical connections and automated processes. A structured and saucy one

• Dokumentation & Auswertung: Sorgfältige Dokumentation aller Arbeitsschritte sowie Auswertung der Rohdaten unter Einhaltung relevanter Qualitätsstandards (GMP).

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in HPLC/ U(H)PLC und Erfahrung in der selbstständigen Durchführung analytischer Methoden; LC-MS Kenntnisse von Vorteil

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a dedicated PI Data Historian, Integration System Engineer (a), workload 80 - 100%.

Your tasks:

• Manage the full lifecycle of the AVEVA PI Data Historian System, including architecture, development, installation, commissioning, maintenance, upgrades, and decommissioning activities.

• Support greenfield and brownfield manufacturing site projects, including deployment of PI infrastructure for new production facilities and expansion projects.

• Lead PI System implementation activities during new manufacturing site start-up phases, including system design, validation, commissioning, and operational readiness.

• Administer a 24/7 operational PI System, ensuring high availability, reliability, performance, and disaster recovery readiness.

• Design, implement, and optimize historian solutions integrating OT equipment, PLCs, SCADA, DCS, MES, and enterprise IT systems.

• Drive end-to-end IT/OT integration activities to enable seamless data flow between manufacturing equipment, automation systems, and business applications.

• Collaborate closely with automation, infrastructure, cybersecurity, manufacturing, and digitalization teams to ensure compliant and scalable system integration.

• Lead change, incident, and problem management processes in collaboration with IT/OT teams, cross-functional stakeholders, vendors, and end users.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to industrial data collection, communication interfaces, data storage, synchronization, and retrieval.

• Translate business and operational requirements into robust technical solutions aligned with manufacturing and digital transformation strategies.
Design and configure complex PI tags, AF structures, event frames, and data models tailored to operational and business needs.

• Develop and maintain custom interfaces, connectors, and scripts to enhance interoperability between OT equipment and enterprise IT platforms.

• Support commissioning and qualification activities for connected manufacturing systems and ensure compliance with GMP and validation requirements.

• Conduct system performance analysis and drive continuous improvement initiatives for historian and integration platforms.

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers and project team members.

• Collaborate with external vendors, system integrators, and engineering partners during project execution and operational support activities.

• Create and maintain comprehensive GMP-compliant documentation, including design specifications, test protocols, validation records, SOPs, and lifecycle documents.

• Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) during audits, inspections, and assessments, ensuring compliance with internal standards, regulatory requireme

descriptionByLocale.it: Il Gruppo Bachem sta investendo in un nuovo sito pianificato a Sisslerfeld nella Svizzera nordoccidentale. Questo passo fa parte della strategia a lungo termine per espandere la capacità produttiva entro la fine del decennio. Il nuovo sito di produzione svolgerà un ruolo centrale nel raggiungimento di questi obiettivi. La fase progettuale del progetto offre opportunità uniche per modellare l'organizzazione futura. Per guidare la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team in Global IT, stiamo cercando un dedicato PI Data Historian, Integration System Engineer (a), workload 80 - 100%. I vostri compiti: Gestire l'intero ciclo di vita del Sistema di Data Historian AVEVA PI, tra cui architettura, sviluppo, installazione, messa in servizio, manutenzione, aggiornamenti e attività di smantellamento. Sostenere i progetti del sito di produzione di greenfield e brownfield, incluso l'implementazione di infrastrutture PI per nuovi impianti di produzione e progetti di espansione. Leader PI Attività di implementazione del sistema durante le nuove fasi di avvio del sito di produzione, tra cui progettazione di sistema, convalida, messa in servizio e disponibilità operativa. Amministrare un sistema PI operativo 24/7, garantendo elevata disponibilità, affidabilità, prestazioni e disponibilità di disaster recovery. Progettazione, implementazione e ottimizzazione di soluzioni storiche che integrano apparecchiature OT, PLC, SCADA, DCS, MES e sistemi IT aziendali. Guidare attività di integrazione IT/OT end-to-end per consentire il flusso di dati senza soluzione di continuità tra attrezzature di produzione, sistemi di automazione e applicazioni aziendali. Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di automazione, infrastruttura, sicurezza informatica, produzione e digitalizzazione per garantire l'integrazione del sistema conforme e scalabile. Processi di cambiamento, incidente e gestione dei problemi in collaborazione con team IT/OT, stakeholder interfunzionali, fornitori e utenti finali. Risoluzione dei problemi e risoluzione di problemi complessi relativi alla raccolta dei dati industriali, interfacce di comunicazione, archiviazione dei dati, sincronizzazione e recupero. Tradurre i requisiti aziendali e operativi in soluzioni tecniche robuste allineate alle strategie di produzione e trasformazione digitale. Progettare e configurare complessi tag PI, strutture AF, frame eventi e modelli di dati su misura per esigenze operative e aziendali. Sviluppare e mantenere interfacce, connettori e script personalizzati per migliorare l'interoperabilità tra attrezzature OT e piattaforme IT aziendali. Supporta le attività di messa in servizio e di qualificazione per i sistemi di produzione collegati e garantisce il rispetto dei requisiti GMP e di validazione. Condurre analisi delle prestazioni del sistema e guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo per le piattaforme storiche e di integrazione. Fornire leadership tecnica e mentorship a ingegneri junior e membri del team di progetto. Collabora con fornitori esterni, integratori di sistema e partner di ingegneria durante le attività di esecuzione e supporto operativo. Creare e mantenere la documentazione completa conforme a GMP, tra cui specifiche di progettazione, protocolli di prova, record di validazione, SOP e documenti del ciclo di vita. Atto come Soggetto Matter Expert (SME) durante gli audit, le ispezioni e le valutazioni, garantendo il rispetto delle norme interne, requisiti normativi

Collaborez étroitement avec les équipes d'automatisation, d'infrastructure, de cybersécurité, de fabrication et de numérisation afin d'assurer une intégration de systèmes conforme et évolutive. Diriger les processus de changement, d'incident et de gestion des problèmes en collaboration avec les équipes TI/OT, les intervenants interfonctionnels, les fournisseurs et les utilisateurs finaux. jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Engineer (a), 80 – 100%.

The IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for designing, governing, and operationalizing enterprise and industrial network infrastructure across IT and OT environments while directly supporting Bachem’s digital strategy (i.e. digital manufacturing, pharma 4.0 concepts), with a strong focus on project delivery (new planned Sisslerfeld site) and long-term operational ownership.

The role acts as the key interface between Global IT, site teams, and project stakeholders, ensuring that all network and hosting components are aligned with corporate standards, security policies, and GxP regulations, while guaranteeing infrastructure readiness for project execution and sustainable operations.

In addition to architecture and delivery responsibilities, the role transitions into the on-site owner for IT run services, ensuring stable operations, vendor coordination, and continuous improvement after project completion.

Your tasks:

• Define, design, and govern network architectures within the BSF site project, aligned with global IT/OT network architectures across enterprise and industrial environments.

• Design and implement segmented IT/OT architectures (zones, DMZs, VLANs, secure data flows) and support industrial environments including SCADA, PLC, DCS, MES, and shop-floor systems.

• Act as primary infrastructure lead during project BSF, coordinating network and hosting activities between site management, project teams and Global IT while ensuring infrastructure readiness (network, connectivity, hosting, security) to support all project milestones and commissioning activities.

• Drive alignment between project design and corporate standards, including architecture reviews and approvals. Support site deployment activities including assessments, design validation, cutovers, testing, and go-live.

• Coordinate integration of network and hosting platforms (on-prem, hybrid, cloud) into end-to-end infrastructure solutions & ensure systems are designed for high availability, security, scalability, and operational sustainability.

• Govern and coordinate external service providers, system integrators, and network vendors. Review designs, proposals, and delivery quality of suppliers.

• Ensure compliance with GxP, data integrity, and cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443, ISO 27001) and support audits, risk assessments, and regulatory inspections.

• Maintain architecture documentation, standards, and validation-relevant deliverables.

• Transition into on-site owner for IT run services after project go-live by defining and establishing support models, runbooks, monitoring, escalation paths, and service KPIs.

• Drive network standardization, modernization, and lifecycle management.

Your profile:

• Extensive experience in network architecture and infrastructure design in enterprise and industrial GxP environments with strong hands-on expertise in LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, routing, switching, firewalls, and network security.

The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization. To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Engineer (a), 80 – 100%. The IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for designing, governing, and operationalizing enterprise and industrial network infrastructure across IT and OT environments while directly supporting Bachem’s digital strategy (i.e. digital manufacturing, pharma 4.0 concepts), with a strong focus on project delivery (new planned Sisslerfeld site) and long-term operational ownership. The role acts as the key interface between Global IT, site teams, and project stakeholders, ensuring that all network and hosting components are aligned with corporate standards, security policies, and GxP regulations, while guaranteeing infrastructure readiness for project execution and sustainable operations. In addition to architecture and delivery responsibilities, the role transitions into the on-site owner for IT run services, ensuring stable operations, vendor coordination, and continuous improvement after project completion.
• Your tasks: Define, design, and govern network architectures within the BSF site project, aligned with global IT/OT network architectures across enterprise and industrial environments. Design and implement segmented IT/OT architectures (zones, DMZs, VLANs, secure data flows) and support industrial environments including SCADA, PLC, DCS, MES, and shop-floor systems. Act as primary infrastructure lead during project BSF, coordinating network and hosting activities between site management, project teams and Global IT while ensuring infrastructure readiness (network, connectivity, hosting, security) to support all project milestones and commissioning activities. Drive alignment between project design and corporate standards, including architecture reviews and approvals. Support site deployment activities including assessments, design validation, cutovers, testing, and go-live. Coordinate integration of network and hosting platforms (on-prem, hybrid, cloud) into end-to-end infrastructure solutions & ensure systems are designed for high availability, security, scalability, and operational sustainability. Govern and coordinate external service providers, system integrators, and network vendors. Review designs, proposals, and delivery quality of suppliers. Ensure compliance with GxP, data integrity, and cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443, ISO 27001) and support audits, risk assessments, and regulatory inspections. Maintain architecture documentation, standards, and validation-relevant deliverables. Transition into on-site owner for IT run services after project go-live by defining and establishing support models, runbooks, monitoring, escalation paths, and service KPIs. Drive network standardization, modernization, and lifecycle management.
• Your profile: Extensive experience in network architecture and infrastructure design in enterprise and industrial GxP environments with strong hands-on expertise in LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, routing, switching, firewalls, and network security. <li style="color:#004
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Engineer (a), 80 – 100%.

The IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for designing, governing, and operationalizing enterprise and industrial network infrastructure across IT and OT environments while directly supporting Bachem’s digital strategy (i.e. digital manufacturing, pharma 4.0 concepts), with a strong focus on project delivery (new planned Sisslerfeld site) and long-term operational ownership.

The role acts as the key interface between Global IT, site teams, and project stakeholders, ensuring that all network and hosting components are aligned with corporate standards, security policies, and GxP regulations, while guaranteeing infrastructure readiness for project execution and sustainable operations.

In addition to architecture and delivery responsibilities, the role transitions into the on-site owner for IT run services, ensuring stable operations, vendor coordination, and continuous improvement after project completion.

Your tasks:

• Define, design, and govern network architectures within the BSF site project, aligned with global IT/OT network architectures across enterprise and industrial environments.

• Design and implement segmented IT/OT architectures (zones, DMZs, VLANs, secure data flows) and support industrial environments including SCADA, PLC, DCS, MES, and shop-floor systems.

• Act as primary infrastructure lead during project BSF, coordinating network and hosting activities between site management, project teams and Global IT while ensuring infrastructure readiness (network, connectivity, hosting, security) to support all project milestones and commissioning activities.

• Drive alignment between project design and corporate standards, including architecture reviews and approvals. Support site deployment activities including assessments, design validation, cutovers, testing, and go-live.

• Coordinate integration of network and hosting platforms (on-prem, hybrid, cloud) into end-to-end infrastructure solutions & ensure systems are designed for high availability, security, scalability, and operational sustainability.

• Govern and coordinate external service providers, system integrators, and network vendors. Review designs, proposals, and delivery quality of suppliers.

• Ensure compliance with GxP, data integrity, and cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443, ISO 27001) and support audits, risk assessments, and regulatory inspections.

• Maintain architecture documentation, standards, and validation-relevant deliverables.

• Transition into on-site owner for IT run services after project go-live by defining and establishing support models, runbooks, monitoring, escalation paths, and service KPIs.

• Drive network standardization, modernization, and lifecycle management.

Your profile:

• Extensive experience in network architecture and infrastructure design in enterprise and industrial GxP environments with strong hands-on expertise in LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, routing, switching, firewalls, and network security.

jobs.title: SAP Solution & Implementation Lead (a), 80 - 100%

titleByLocale.fr: Solution SAP et responsable de la mise en œuvre (a), 80 - 100%

jobs.description: The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization. To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking SAP Solution & Implementation Lead (a), 80 – 100% , to design and implement SAP solutions for the establishment of our new planned GMP manufacturing site (Bachem Sisslerfeld). The role combines deep expertise in pharmaceutical manufacturing and supply chain processes with a strong focus on modern, data-driven capabilities and digital innovation. This includes enabling integrated, intelligent, and highly automated processes based on advanced digital technologies. The successful candidate will contribute to building scalable, integrated, and future-ready SAP solutions to support digital transformation and operational excellence. Your tasks: • Design, implement, and continuously improve scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions supporting manufacturing and supply chain processes, ensuring compliant, standardized system build and deployment across the program • Enable and optimize end-to-end business processes across production, supply chain, and quality in GMP-regulated environments, applying deep pharma/life science domain expertise • Architect and implement cross-system integration across SAP and adjacent platforms (MES, LIMS, shopfloor automation), securing seamless data flow and process consistency across the landscape • Drive digital innovation by delivering data-driven, highly automated processes and supporting the adoption of modern SAP technologies such as SAP Build and SAP AI Services • Establish and maintain full regulatory compliance (GxP, CFR Part 11, Annex 11, ISO 27001), supporting computer system validation (CSV), risk assessments, and audit readiness • Engage senior stakeholders across manufacturing, quality, supply chain and IT; translate business needs into architectural solutions and provide governance across program and project lifecycles Your profile: • Bachelor's or Master's in IT, Engineering, or related field • A minimum of seven years in SAP solution design & implementation • Expertise in ISA-95 integration (MES Level 3 / ERP Level 4–5) • Hands-on SAP S/4HANA and SAP BTP experience • Knowledge of GxP, CFR Part 11, Annex 11, ISO 27001 • MES and OT/automation systems experience a strong plus • Fluency in German and English required • Experience in regulated industries is a plus Our offer

descriptionByLocale.it: Il Gruppo Bachem sta investendo in un nuovo sito pianificato a Sisslerfeld nella Svizzera nordoccidentale. Questo passo fa parte della strategia a lungo termine per espandere la capacità produttiva entro la fine del decennio. Il nuovo sito di produzione svolgerà un ruolo centrale nel raggiungimento di questi obiettivi. La fase progettuale del progetto offre opportunità uniche per modellare l'organizzazione futura. Per guidare la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team in Global IT, stiamo cercando un SAP Solution & Implementation Lead (a), 80 – 100% , per progettare e implementare soluzioni SAP per la creazione del nostro nuovo sito di produzione GMP (Bachem Sisslerfeld). Il ruolo combina una profonda esperienza nei processi di produzione farmaceutica e supply chain con una forte attenzione alle capacità moderne, basate sui dati e all'innovazione digitale. Ciò include l'attivazione di processi integrati, intelligenti e altamente automatizzati basati su tecnologie digitali avanzate. Il candidato di successo contribuirà alla costruzione di soluzioni SAP scalabili, integrate e pronte al futuro per supportare la trasformazione digitale e l'eccellenza operativa. I vostri compiti: Progettare, implementare e migliorare continuamente le soluzioni SAP S/4HANA scalabili che supportano i processi di produzione e supply chain, assicurando la costruzione e la distribuzione di sistemi conformi e standardizzati in tutto il programma Abilitare e ottimizzare i processi aziendali end-to-end attraverso la produzione, la catena di fornitura e la qualità in ambienti regolati da GMP, applicando competenze di dominio della scienza della farm/vita Architetto e implementa l'integrazione tra i sistemi su piattaforme SAP e adiacenti (MES, LIMS, automazione del laboratorio), garantendo un flusso di dati senza soluzione di continuità e una coerenza di processo in tutto il paesaggio Guidare l'innovazione digitale offrendo processi altamente automatizzati e basati sui dati e supportando l'adozione di tecnologie SAP moderne come SAP Build e SAP AI Services Stabilire e mantenere la piena conformità normativa (GxP, CFR Parte 11, Allegato 11, ISO 27001), supportando la validazione del sistema informatico (CSV), le valutazioni dei rischi e la disponibilità di audit Coinvolgere gli stakeholder senior attraverso la produzione, la qualità, la supply chain e l'IT; tradurre le esigenze aziendali in soluzioni architettoniche e fornire governance attraverso programmi e cicli di vita di progetto Il tuo profilo: Bachelor o Master in IT, Ingegneria o campo relativo Un minimo di sette anni nella progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni SAP Competenza nell'integrazione ISA-95 (livello MES 3 / livello ERP 4–5) Esperienza SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP Conoscenza di GxP, CFR Parte 11, Allegato 11, ISO 27001 I sistemi MES e OT/automazione sperimentano un forte plus Fluency in tedesco e inglese richiesto L'esperienza nelle industrie regolamentate è un plus La nostra offerta

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Bachem-Gruppe investiert in einen neuen geplanten Standort in Sisslerfeld in der Nordwestschweiz. Dieser Schritt ist Teil der langfristigen Strategie, die Produktionskapazitäten bis zum Ende des Jahrzehnts zu erweitern. Der neue Produktionsstandort wird eine zentrale Rolle bei der Erreichung dieser Ziele spielen. Die Entwurfsphase des Projekts bietet Ihnen einzigartige Möglichkeiten, die zukünftige Organisation zu gestalten. Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, sind wir ständig auf der Suche nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Um unser Team in der globalen IT zu stärken, suchen wir einen erfahrenen und zukunftsweisenden SAP Solution & Implementation Lead (a), 80 – 100%, um SAP-Lösungen für den Aufbau unseres neuen geplanten GMP-Produktionsstandorts (Bachem Sisslerfeld) zu entwerfen und zu implementieren. Die Rolle verbindet umfassende Expertise in der pharmazeutischen Herstellung und Supply-Chain-Prozesse mit einem starken Fokus auf moderne, datengetriebene Fähigkeiten und digitale Innovation. Dazu gehört die Ermöglichung integrierter, intelligenter und hochautomatisierter Prozesse auf Basis fortschrittlicher digitaler Technologien. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird dazu beitragen, skalierbare, integrierte und zukunftsfähige SAP-Lösungen zu entwickeln, die die digitale Transformation und operative Exzellenz unterstützen. • Ihre Aufgaben: Entwurf, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung skalierbarer SAP S/4HANA-Lösungen, die Fertigungs- und Lieferkettenprozesse unterstützen und eine konforme, standardisierte Systementwicklung und -bereitstellung im gesamten Programm sicherstellen Ermöglichung und Optimierung von End-to-End-Geschäftsprozessen in Produktion, Lieferkette und Qualität in GMP-regulierten Umgebungen unter Anwendung von fundiertem Fachwissen im Bereich Pharma / Life Science Systemübergreifende Integration über SAP und angrenzende Plattformen (MES, LIMS, Shopfloor-Automatisierung) aufbauen und implementieren, um einen nahtlosen Datenfluss und eine Prozesskonsistenz in der gesamten Landschaft zu gewährleisten Digitale Innovation fördern durch datengesteuerte, hochautomatisierte Prozesse und die Unterstützung der Einführung moderner SAP-Technologien wie SAP Build und SAP AI Services Vollständige Einhaltung der Vorschriften (GxP, CFR Part 11, Annex 11, ISO 27001), Unterstützung der Computersystemvalidierung (CSV), Risikobewertungen und Prüfungsbereitschaft Engagieren Sie leitende Stakeholder in den Bereichen Fertigung, Qualität, Lieferkette und IT; Übersetzen von Geschäftsanforderungen in architektonische Lösungen und Bereitstellung von Governance über Programm- und Projektlebenszyklen hinweg • Ihr Profil: Bachelor oder Master in IT, Engineering oder verwandten Bereichen Mindestens sieben Jahre in SAP Solution Design & Implementierung Expertise in der ISA-95-Integration (MES Level 3 / ERP Level 4–5) SAP S/4HANA und SAP BTP Erfahrung Kenntnisse von GxP, CFR Teil 11, Anhang 11, ISO 27001 MES und OT/Automatisierungssysteme erleben ein starkes Plus Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch erforderlich Erfahrung in regulierten Branchen ist ein Plus Unser Angebot
descriptionByLocale.fr: Le groupe Bachem investit dans un nouveau site prévu à Sisslerfeld dans le nord-ouest de la Suisse. Cette étape s'inscrit dans la stratégie à long terme visant à accroître la capacité de production d'ici la fin de la décennie. Le nouveau site de production jouera un rôle central dans la réalisation de ces objectifs. La phase de conception du projet vous offre des occasions uniques de façonner la future organisation. Pour stimuler notre croissance organique continue, nous recherchons constamment des professionnels hautement qualifiés. Pour renforcer notre équipe en TI globale, nous recherchons une solution SAP expérimentée et avant-gardiste et un leader de mise en œuvre (a), 80 – 100%, pour concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions SAP pour la création de notre nouveau site de fabrication GMP (Bachem Sisslerfeld). Ce rôle combine une expertise approfondie dans la fabrication pharmaceutique et les processus de la chaîne d'approvisionnement avec un accent fort sur les capacités modernes, axées sur les données et l'innovation numérique. Cela comprend des processus intégrés, intelligents et hautement automatisés fondés sur des technologies numériques de pointe. Le candidat retenu contribuera à l'élaboration de solutions SAP évolutives, intégrées et prêtes à l'avenir pour soutenir la transformation numérique et l'excellence opérationnelle. • Vos tâches: Concevoir, mettre en œuvre et améliorer continuellement les solutions évolutives SAP S/4HANA qui soutiennent les processus de fabrication et de chaîne d'approvisionnement, en assurant la conformité et la normalisation de la construction et du déploiement du système dans l'ensemble du programme Permettre et optimiser les processus opérationnels de bout en bout dans les environnements réglementés par les BPF, tout au long de la production, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et de la qualité, en appliquant une expertise approfondie en matière de pharmacologie et de sciences de la vie Architecte et implémente l'intégration des systèmes transversaux sur les plateformes SAP et adjacentes (MES, LIMS, automatisation des ateliers), assurant un flux de données sans faille et une cohérence des processus dans l'ensemble du paysage Favoriser l'innovation numérique en fournissant des processus hautement automatisés et axés sur les données et en soutenant l'adoption de technologies SAP modernes telles que SAP Build et SAP AI Services Établir et maintenir une conformité complète à la réglementation (GxP, CFR Part 11, annexe 11, ISO 27001), appuyer la validation des systèmes informatiques (CSV), les évaluations des risques et la préparation à la vérification Faire participer les principaux intervenants de la fabrication, de la qualité, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et de la TI; traduire les besoins des entreprises en solutions architecturales et assurer la gouvernance au cours des cycles de vie des programmes et des projets • Votre profil: Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, génie ou domaine connexe Un minimum de sept ans dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions SAP Expertise en intégration ISA-95 (MES niveau 3 / ERP niveau 4–5) Expérience pratique SAP S/4HANA et SAP BTP Connaissance de GxP, CFR Partie 11, Annexe 11, ISO 27001 Les systèmes MES et OT/automation connaissent un fort plus Connaissances en allemand et en anglais requises L'expérience dans les industries réglementées est un plus Notre offre

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable HSE Développement du Site BSF 100% - Sisslerfeld(a)

jobs.description:
To support our continued organic growth and the development of a major Greenfield project , we are seeking highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team at the site level, we are looking for a dedicated HSE Manager BSF Site Development (a), 100 - Sisslerfeld . In this key role, you will ensure a safe, compliant, and sustainable working environment across all our site operations.

Your tasks:

• Lead the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of all HSE concepts and standards.

• Act as the main responsible person for HSE internally and externally.

• Develop and execute hazard and risk assessments (e.g., HAZID, HAZOP).

• Establish occupational health, safety, and industrial hygiene programs; coordinate and document hygiene measurements.

• Define HSE requirements for site projects and ensure alignment with Quality/GMP, Global HSE, and local HSE teams.

• Cooperate with fire brigade, emergency services, and external authorities on emergency management.

• Create, review, and approve HSE-related procedures and documentation (SOPs, VORs, policies).

• Deliver HSE training and promote behavior‑based safety on site.

• Support sustainability initiatives and monitor regulatory developments.

• Build and develop a strong HSE organization and act as a role model in change management.

Your Profile:

• Degree in Chemistry, Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field

• Several years of solid HSE experience

• Deep understanding of chemical production processes and safety controls

• Strong digital and IT competence

• Experience applying modern HSE methodologies and staying up‑to‑date with evolving regulations

• Experience in ensuring alignment with Quality/GMP, Global HSE and internal site HSE teams

• Ability to train, coach and educate employees on HSE regulations and safety culture

• Strong project‑management skills to support large‑scale site or construction projects

• Leadership mindset, able to lead according to corporate leadership principles and foster entrepreneurial thinking

• Strong communication & stakeholder management

• Experience in Swiss/EU regulatory frameworks (optional but valuable)

• Fluent in German

descriptionByLocale.it:
Responsabilità - Guidare l'implementazione, il monitoraggio e il miglioramento continuo di tutti i concetti e gli standard HSE. - Agire come principale responsabile HSE internamente ed esternamente. - Sviluppare ed eseguire valutazioni dei pericoli e dei rischi (ad es. HAZID, HAZOP). - Stabilire programmi di salute, sicurezza e igiene industriale sul lavoro; coordinare e documentare le misurazioni igieniche. - Definire i requisiti HSE per i progetti del sito e garantire l'allineamento con qualità/GMP, HSE globale e team HSE locali. - Collaborare con i vigili del fuoco, i servizi di emergenza e le autorità esterne nella gestione delle emergenze. - Creare, rivedere e approvare procedure e documentazione relative all'HSE (SOP, VOR, politiche). - Fornire formazione HSE e promuovere la sicurezza basata sul comportamento in loco. - Sostenere le iniziative di sostenibilità e monitorare gli sviluppi normativi. - Costruire e sviluppare una solida organizzazione HSE e fungere da modello nella gestione del cambiamento.
• Requisiti - Laurea in Chimica, Ingegneria, Farmacia o in un campo correlato - Diversi anni di solida esperienza HSE - Profonda conoscenza dei processi di produzione chimica e dei controlli di sicurezza - Forte competenza digitale e IT - Esperienza nell'applicazione di moderne metodologie HSE e nel mantenersi aggiornati con le normative in evoluzione - Esperienza nel garantire l'allineamento con i team HSE di qualità/GMP, HSE globale e interno al sito - Capacità di formare, istruire e istruire i dipendenti sulle normative HSE e sulla cultura della sicurezza - Forti capacità di gestione del progetto a supporto del sito su largascala

jobs.description:
Die Bachem Gruppe investiert in einen neuen Standort im Sisslerfeld in der Nordwestschweiz. Dieser Schritt ist Teil der langfristigen Strategie, bis zum Ende des Jahrzehnts die Produktionskapazitäten auszubauen. Der neue Produktionsstandort wird dabei eine zentrale Rolle bei der Erreichung dieser Ziele spielen. Die Designphase des Projekts bietet Ihnen einzigartige Möglichkeiten, die zukünftige Organisation mitzugestalten.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Global Quality Abteilung Sisslerfeld suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Senior Manager QA Compliance & Systems (a), 100%.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Planung, Aufbau, Führung und Weiterentwicklung der Organisationseinheit Quality Systems und Compliance am Standort Sisslerfeld

• Beobachtung der sich ändernden Pharma-Gesetzgebung und deren Bachem-interne Umsetzung

• Unterstützung bei der Koordinierung der Aktivitäten interner und externer Beteiligter, um die rechtzeitige Erreichung von Projektmeilensteinen zu gewährleisten

• Aufbau und Implementierung der Qualitätsmanagement-Systeme und -Prozesse und deren kontinuierliche Verbesserung

• Definition von qualitätsrelevanten Kennzahlen sowie Planung und Durchführung des Quality Management Reviews unter aktiver Einbeziehung der Standortleitung

• Sicherstellung der Compliance mit regulatorischen Anforderungen, wie z.B. Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP)

• Erstellung, Review und Genehmigung von Site Master File, Policies & SOPs etc. im Fachbereich sowie Abstimmung mit globalen Prozessen

• Kontakt und Interaktion mit Swissmedic, Regionales Heilmittelinstitut und weiteren relevanten Behörden (z.B. Einreichung von Änderungsmeldungen, Planung von Behördeninspektionen etc.)

• Planung, Koordination und Durchführung von Mock-Audits und Selbstinspektionen als Vorbereitung zum Erreichen der «Site-License» und zur Überprüfung der Einhaltung von Qualitätsstandards

• Präsentation der QM-Prozesse des Fachbereichs während Kundenaudits und Behördeninspektionen

• Verantwortlich für die Implementierung der Durchführung von Schulungen und Trainings für Mitarbeitende in Bezug auf Qualitätsmanagement und regulatorische Anforderungen

• Mitarbeit und Unterstützung von globalen Projekten des Qualitätsmanagements im Fachbereich Quality Systems und Compliance

• Zusammenarbeit mit Interessengruppen auf allen Ebenen der Organisation, um die Abstimmung und Unterstützung von Verbesserungsinitiativen sicherzustellen

• Fähigkeit am bestehenden Markt stets über den Tellerrand hinauszublicken, sich weiterzubilden und neue Q-relevante Herausforderungen der kommenden Jahre zu antizipieren

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der cGMP-Compliance der relevanten regulatorischen Anforderungen und des Qualitätssicherungssystems

• Förderung einer Qualitätskultur innerhalb der Organisation durch Vorbildwirkung

• Übernahme von sonstigen/zusätzlichen Aufgaben nach Anweisung

• Verantwortlich für die E

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il gruppo Bachem investe in una nuova sede a Sisslerfeld, nella Svizzera nordoccidentale. Questo passo fa parte della strategia a lungo termine volta ad espandere la capacità produttiva entro la fine del decennio. Il nuovo sito produttivo avrà un ruolo centrale nel raggiungimento di questi obiettivi. La fase di progettazione del progetto offre opportunità uniche per contribuire a dare forma alla futura organizzazione. Per rafforzare il nostro team nel dipartimento Qualità globale di Sisslerfeld, stiamo cercando un Senior Manager QA Compliance & Systems (a) dedicato al 100%. I vostri compiti:
• Pianificare, impostare, guidare e sviluppare ulteriormente l'unità organizzativa Sistemi di qualità e conformità presso la sede di Sisslerfeld
• Monitorare l'evoluzione della legislazione farmaceutica e la sua attuazione interna presso Bachem
• Supportare il coordinamento delle attività di soggetti interni ed esterni per garantire il tempestivo raggiungimento delle tappe fondamentali del progetto
• Impostazione e attuazione dei sistemi e dei processi di gestione della qualità e il loro miglioramento continuo
• Definizione di cifre chiave rilevanti per la qualità nonché pianificazione ed esecuzione del riesame della gestione della qualità con il coinvolgimento attivo della direzione della sede
• Garantire la conformità ai requisiti normativi, come Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP)
• Creazione, revisione e approvazione di file master del sito, policy e SOP ecc. nel dipartimento nonché coordinamento con i processi globali
• Contatto e interazione con Swissmedic, Istituto regionale per gli agenti terapeutici e altre autorità competenti (ad es. Presentazione di rapporti di modifica, pianificazione delle ispezioni delle autorità, ecc.)
• Pianificazione, coordinamento ed esecuzione di audit simulati e autoispezioni come preparazione per ottenere la "licenza del sito" e per verificare la conformità agli standard di qualità
• Presentazione dei processi QM del dipartimento durante gli audit dei clienti e le ispezioni delle autorità
• Responsabile dell'attuazione dei corsi di formazione per i dipendenti in relazione alla gestione della qualità e ai requisiti normativi
• Collaborazione e supporto di progetti di gestione della qualità globale nel dipartimento Sistemi di qualità e conformità
• Collaborare con le parti interessate a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione garantire il coordinamento e il supporto delle iniziative di miglioramento
• Capacità di pensare sempre fuori dagli schemi nel mercato esistente, continuare la formazione e anticipare nuove sfide rilevanti per la qualità nei prossimi anni
• Garantire la conformità cGMP con i requisiti normativi pertinenti e il sistema di garanzia della qualità
• Promuovere una cultura della qualità all'interno dell'organizzazione dando l'esempio
• Assumere compiti altri/ulteriori come indicato
• Responsabile dell'E

jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the Global Engineering department, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Lead (f/m/d), 100%.

In this role, you are responsible for the strategic planning, execution, and oversight of commissioning, qualification, and validation activities for GMP ‑ regulated pharmaceutical facilities. Furthermore, this role ensures that all systems, equipment, and utilities are delivered in full compliance with regulatory requirements, quality standards, and project timelines. Acting as a technical and regulatory leader, the position interfaces closely with Engineering, Quality, Automation, Operations, and external partners throughout the project lifecycle.

Your tasks:

• Lead and manage commissioning, qualification, and validation activities for pharmaceutical facilities, utilities, equipment, automation, and computerized systems

• Develop and implement C&Q strategies, C&Q Master Plans, and risk ‑ based qualification approaches

• Author, review, and approve GMP documentation including URS, risk assessments, IQ/OQ/PQ protocols and reports

• Ensure compliance with GMP regulations and internal quality standards

• Act as the primary C&Q interface to Quality Assurance and support regulatory inspections and audits

• Coordinate cross ‑ functional stakeholders and manage external vendors and CQV consultants

• Monitor progress, manage risks, deviations, and change controls, and provide transparent reporting to project leadership

• Drive standardization, continuous improvement, and best practices across C&Q activities

Your profile:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related technical discipline

• Extensive experience in Commissioning & Qualification / Validation within the pharmaceutical industry

• Proven track record of leading C&Q activities on large scale GMP capital projects

• Strong knowledge of GMP regulations (EU/FDA), ISPE guidelines, and risk based qualification methodologies

• Experience with facilities and utilities (e.g. HVAC, media systems); automation and CSV experience is an advantage

• Excellent written and spoken German and English

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Global Engineering Abteilung suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Construction Management Lead (w/m/d), 100%.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Entwicklung, Standardisierung und Durchsetzung von Construction‑, HSE‑ und Qualitätsstandards

• Beratung der Projektteams zu technischen, organisatorischen und regulatorischen Themen inklusive Baubarkeitsprüfungen

• Überwachung der gesamten Projektlandschaft, Identifikation von Risiken und Eskalation an das Management

• Steuerung von Bauabläufen, Gewerken, Fachbauleitern und externen Partnern im GMP‑Umfeld

• Prüfung von Plänen, Bauzeitplanung, Fortschrittsberichten und Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen

• Durchführung von Sicherheitsbegehungen, Risikoanalysen und Durchsetzung von Sicherheitsregeln gemäß SIA 118

• Sicherstellung GMP‑konformer Dokumentation inklusive Bautagebuch, Abnahmen, Prüfberichten und Mechanical Completion

• Erfahrung im GMP‑Umfeld aus Pharma, Biotech oder Chemie von Vorteil

• Kenntnisse in EPC/EPCM‑Strukturen und komplexen Stakeholder‑Umgebungen

• Fundierte Kenntnisse der Schweizer Bau‑ und Sicherheitsvorschriften

• Ausgeprägte Führungs‑ und Governance‑Kompetenz sowie diplomatisches Durchsetzungsvermögen

• Strukturierte, proaktive und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Fähigkeit, mehrere Projektebenen parallel zu steuern

jobs.title: Global IT/OT Network Architect (a), 100%

titleByLocale.fr: Architecte réseau mondial IT/OT (f/m/d), 100%

jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the Global IT department, we are looking for a dedicated Global IT/OT Network Architect (f/m/d), 100%.

The Global IT/OT Network Architect defines and governs the company’s global network architecture across enterprise IT and operational technology environments, directly supporting Bachem’s digital strategy (digital manufacturing, pharma 4.0 concepts).

The role combines full ownership and design authority of enterprise & industrial/OT network architecture, and site-level solution architecture for offices, production environments, warehouses, and laboratories, including a multi-year IT/OT network strategy and roadmap.

The role ensures that IT and OT networks are secure, resilient, scalable, standardized, maintainable, and aligned with business, operational, cybersecurity, and GxP compliance requirements.

Your tasks :

• Define and maintain global network architecture standards for enterprise, industrial, cloud, and site environments across global sites. Assume full ownership and design authority for global network architecture.

• Support Bachem’s digital strategy, in particular digital manufacturing and Pharma 4.0 concepts, and provide technical governance for managed service providers, telecom carriers, automation vendors, and OT system integrators.

• Own a multi-year IT/OT network strategy and roadmap, including modernization, standardization, technical debt reduction, and end-of-life planning.

• Design secure and resilient OT network architectures for shop-floor and production environments, including IT/OT segmentation using zones, conduits, DMZs, firewalls, VLANs, access controls, and controlled data flows.

• Ensure local network designs align with global standards and site-specific operational needs by supporting design reviews, commissioning, cutovers, migrations, acceptance testing, and post-implementation validation.

• Ensure network architecture supports cybersecurity, risk, and GxP compliance requirements across IT and OT by aligning with internal policies and relevant standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, NIST OT security guidance, and ITIL practices.

• Maintain architecture documentation, including standards, reference architectures, site blueprints, segmentation models, design templates, decision records, exceptions, and risk acceptance documentation.

• Ensure designs are operationally supportable by IT, OT, site, and managed service teams, and define operational runbooks, support models, escalation paths, and disaster recovery requirements.

Your profile:

• Extensive experience in network architecture, infrastructure architecture, or senior network engineering in global or multi-site enterprise environments, ensuring GxP compliance.

• Practical experience with OT or industrial networks designing IT/OT segmentation and secure connectivity patterns in manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, or similar environments.

Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Freigabelabors der Entwicklungsabteilung QC Early Phase suchen wir eine/n engagierten Associate Scientist Quality Control.

Wir suchen:

Als engagierte und motivierte Persönlichkeit bist Du Teil unserer agilen Entwicklungsabteilung. Es erwarten dich vielfältige Aufgaben und Fragestellungen in einem dynamischen und spannenden Umfeld. Dabei verantwortest Du im Schwerpunkt Analysen von Oligonukleotidwirkstoffen unter GMP sowie deren Stabilitätsprüfungen.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Anwendung chromatographischer Methoden zur Freigabe- und Stabilitätsprüfungen unserer Wirkstoffe unter GMP

• Gewissenhafte Dokumentation, Auswertung und Überprüfung von Analysen

• Mitarbeit bei der Wartung und Qualifizierung von Analysengeräten

• Teilnahme an Optimierungs- und Entwicklungsprojekten

• Möglichkeit zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung durch Mitarbeit an softwaregestützter Durchführung und Dokumentation von GMP-Analysen

• Erarbeitung nachhaltiger Verbesserungen für alle analytischen Fragestellungen im Methodenlebenszyklus

• Enge Zusammenarbeit in einem motivierten dynamischen Team, einschließlich der Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Methodenentwicklern

Dein fachliches Profil:

• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Chemie, Lebensmittelchemie oder Pharmazie

• Berufserfahrung oder Ausbildungsschwerpunkt in instrumenteller Analytik mit Schwerpunkt Chromatographie (HPLC)

• Erfahrungen in der Analytik von Oligonukleotiden

• Kenntnisse in gängigen im GMP-Umfeld üblichen IT-Applikationen (z.B. Chromeleon, LIMS, SAP) sowie allgemeine Softwareaffinität

• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Teamplayer

• Zuverlässige Persönlichkeit mit Begeisterung für Verantwortung und Eigeninitiative

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Chromatographie suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Chemie-& Pharmatechnologe im Schichtbetrieb (a), in Vollzeit .

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Durchführung chemischer Prozessschritte im Produktionsumfeld (z. B. Zyklisierung, Decarboxylierung, Faltung, Destillation) gemäss Herstellvorschriften

• Herstellung und Handling von Puffern, Lösungen, Lösungsmitteln, Wirkstoffen und Suspensionen inkl. Vorlegen/Einziehen von Prozesslösungen gemäss HVO

• Filtration von Prozess- und Produktlösungen sowie Packen/Entpacken von Chromatographiesäulen inkl. Vorbereitung von Säulen-Suspensionen

• Prozesskontrolle inkl. Scannen, Wiegen, Kalibrieren von pH-Messgeräten, pH-Einstellung, Probenzug und Anmeldung zur Analytik

• Bedienung von Automationssystemen (SIMATIC PCS7 / PAX X, WinCC, SIMATIC Batch) sowie grundlegendes Verständnis von Verdränger- und Kreiselpumpen

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemie- und Pharmatechnologe/-login EFZ (oder vergleichbar) oder mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem chemischen oder pharmazeutischen Produktionsumfeld

• Fundiertes Verständnis für Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) sowie ein ausgeprägtes Sicherheits- und Qualitätsbewusstsein

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Bereitschaft zum Mehrschichtmodell: 3-3-3 (3 Früh-3 Spät- 3 Frei) sowie  6-4 Schichtbetrieb (6 Tage Arbeit – 4 Tage frei)

• Idealerweise Erfahrung im GMP-regulierten Umfeld sowie im Umgang mit Produktionsanlagen und Reaktoren

• Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse in HPLC, Ultrafiltration (UF/DF) oder elektronischen Batch Records (z. B. PAS-X)

• Interesse an kontinuierlicher Verbesserung (Continuous Improvement, 5S) und an der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen

Unser Angebot:

• Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

• Firmeninterne KITA auf dem Bachem Campus Bubendorf

• 60%-ige Übernahme der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem AG sowie Möglichkeit für überobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Wahlsparplan

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Abteilung Global Engineering suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Project Director Grossprojekte (a), 100%.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Gesamtverantwortung für komplexe Gross- und Investitionsprojekte (Capex) über alle Projektphasen hinweg – von der Machbarkeitsstudie bis zur Übergabe an den Betrieb.

• Leitung und Steuerung von Machbarkeits-, Varianten- und Konzeptstudien inklusive technischer, wirtschaftlicher und regulatorischer Bewertung sowie Entscheidungsaufbereitung für Management-Gremien.

• Auswahl und Steuerung geeigneter Projektabwicklungsmodelle (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) aus Bauherren-/Owner-Sicht.

• Sicherstellung der Produktionsbereitschaft sowie der GMP-, Sicherheits- und Gesetzeskonformität von Anlagen, Gebäuden und Infrastrukturen.

• Konzeption, Planung und Umsetzung von Neu- und Umbauten inklusive Integration von Prozess-, Automatisierungs- und Gebäudethemen.

• Führung interdisziplinärer Projektteams sowie Steuerung externer Partner und Dienstleister.

• Planung, Überwachung und Durchführung von Inbetriebnahme und Qualifizierung neuer Anlagen und Gebäude.

• Budgetverantwortung inkl. Planung, Konsolidierung und Überwachung von Investitions- und Betriebskosten.

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossenes technisches Hochschulstudium (ETH/FH/TU) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Gross- und Investitionsprojekte im industriellen Umfeld, idealerweise GMP-reguliert.

• Fundierte Erfahrung mit Projektabwicklungsmodellen wie EPCm, EPC und AE&CM.

• Erfahrung in frühen Projektphasen (Machbarkeits- und Konzeptstudien) sowie in Governance- und Entscheidungsprozessen.

• Gutes technisches Gesamtverständnis für Prozess-, Automatisierungs- und Gebäudethemen.

• Erfahrung im Budget- und Investitionsmanagement (Capex/Opex).

• Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Koordinationsfähigkeit.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

Unser Angebot:

• Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per favorire la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di specialisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team nel dipartimento di Ingegneria Globale, stiamo cercando un Direttore di Progetto impegnato per progetti di grandi dimensioni (f/m/d), al 100%.
• I tuoi compiti: responsabilità generale per progetti complessi su larga scala e di investimento (capex) in tutte le fasi del progetto, dallo studio di fattibilità alla consegna alle operazioni. Gestione e controllo di studi di fattibilità, varianti e concettuali, compresa la valutazione tecnica, economica e normativa, nonché la preparazione delle decisioni per i comitati di gestione. Selezione e controllo di modelli di gestione del progetto adeguati (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) dal punto di vista del cliente/proprietario. Garantire la preparazione alla produzione, nonché le GMP, la sicurezza e la conformità legale di sistemi, edifici e infrastrutture. Concezione, pianificazione e realizzazione di nuovi edifici e conversioni, inclusa l'integrazione di temi di processo, automazione e costruzione. Guidare team di progetto interdisciplinari e gestire partner esterni e fornitori di servizi. Pianificazione, monitoraggio e realizzazione della messa in servizio e qualificazione di nuovi impianti ed edifici. Responsabilità del budget, inclusa la pianificazione, il consolidamento e il monitoraggio dei costi di investimento e operativi. Il tuo profilo: diploma universitario tecnico (ETH/FH/TU) o titolo comparabile. Diversi anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti complessi su larga scala e di investimento in un ambiente industriale, idealmente regolamentato dalle GMP. Profonda esperienza con modelli di consegna di progetti come EPCm, EPC e AE&CM. Esperienza nelle prime fasi del progetto (studi di fattibilità e concettuali), nonché nei processi di governance e decisionali. Buona conoscenza tecnica generale dei processi, dell'automazione e degli argomenti di costruzione. Esperienza nella gestione del budget e degli investimenti (Capex/Opex). Diversi anni di esperienza di leadership e forti capacità di comunicazione e coordinamento. Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e buon inglese. La nostra offerta: un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo interno e ulteriore formazione <li style="color:#004080;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:8.0pt;line-height:107%;font-size
descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to drive our continued organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified specialists. To strengthen our team in the Global Engineering department, we are looking for a committed Project Director for large projects (f/m/d), 100%.
• Your tasks: Overall responsibility for complex large-scale and investment projects (capex) across all project phases - from the feasibility study to handover to operations. Management and control of feasibility, variant and concept studies including technical, economic and regulatory assessment as well as decision preparation for management committees. Selection and control of suitable project management models (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) from the client/owner perspective. Ensuring production readiness as well as GMP, safety and legal compliance of systems, buildings and infrastructures. Conception, planning and implementation of new buildings and conversions including integration of process, automation and building topics. Leading interdisciplinary project teams and managing external partners and service providers. Planning, monitoring and implementation of commissioning and qualification of new systems and buildings. Budget responsibility including planning, consolidation and monitoring of investment and operating costs.
• Your profile: Completed technical university degree (ETH/FH/TU) or comparable qualification. Several years of experience in managing complex large-scale and investment projects in an industrial environment, ideally GMP-regulated. Profound experience with project delivery models such as EPCm, EPC and AE&CM. Experience in early project phases (feasibility and concept studies) as well as in governance and decision-making processes. Good overall technical understanding of process, automation and building topics. Experience in budget and investment management (Capex/Opex). Several years of leadership experience as well as strong communication and coordination skills. Very good knowledge of German and good English. Our offer: A dynamic and rapidly growing working environment with internal development and further training opportunities <li style="color:#004080;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:8.0pt;line-height:107%;font-size

jobs.title: Senior Production Logistics Technician 100% (a)

titleByLocale.fr: Technicien Logistique Production Senior à Temps Complet (h/f/d)

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der «Peptide Manufacturing Support» suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Senior Production Logistics Technician 100% (a)

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Sicherstellung der termingerechten Versorgung der Produktionslinien mit Materialien (Rohstoffe, Halb- und Fertigwaren)

• Kommissionierung von Produktionsaufträgen in unterschiedlichen Lagerzonen (tiefgekühlt, gekühlt, ungekühlt)

• Durchführung von Lagerbewegungen, Umbuchungen und Transfers zwischen Lager- und Produktionsbereichen

• GMP-/cGMP-konforme Dokumentation sowie Unterstützung bei internen und externen Audits

• Bedienung, Pflege und sichere Nutzung logistischer Hilfsmittel unter Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards

• Stellvertretung der Teamleitung im Tagesgeschäft (Materialfluss, Priorisierung, Eskalationen)

• Analyse und Optimierung von Logistikprozessen

• Schulung, Einarbeitung und Coaching von Mitarbeitenden in Logistikprozessen

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Bereich Logistik/Lager, idealerweise mit Weiterbildung in Logistikmanagement

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Logistik, vorzugsweise in einem GMP-regulierten Umfeld

• Grundkenntnisse in cGMP sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen

• Kenntnisse in Prozessanalyse sowie Lean- oder kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmethoden

• Gute IT- und Sprachkenntnisse entsprechend den Anforderungen der Rolle

• Zuverlässige, sorgfältige und qualitätsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Hohe Selbstständigkeit, ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeit und Entscheidungsstärke

Unser Angebot:

• Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung mit Möglichkeit für Home-Office und Option zum Bezug zusätzlicher Ferientage mit reduziertem Arbeitspensum

• Mitarbeiterförderung durch zahlreiche interne und externe Weiterbildungsangebote

• 60%-ige Übernahme der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem AG sowie Möglichkeit für überobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Wahlsparplan

• Vielfältige kostenlose Sportaktivitäten auf dem Bachem Campus

Bei Bachem  finden Sie ein vielfältiges, multikulturelles Team. (a)  steht im Stellentitel für alle . Wir freuen uns auf Bewerbungen aller Menschen. Die Fähigkeiten und die Motivation zählen – völlig unabhängig von Alter oder Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion oder sexueller Orientierung.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per favorire la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di specialisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team nel "Supporto alla produzione di peptidi" stiamo cercando un tecnico senior della logistica di produzione dedicato al 100% (m/f/d)
• I tuoi compiti: Garantire la fornitura tempestiva delle linee di produzione con materiali (materie prime, semilavorati e prodotti finiti) Raccogliere ordini di produzione in diverse zone di stoccaggio (congelate, refrigerate, non raffreddate) Effettuare movimenti di magazzino, riprenotazioni e trasferimenti tra aree di stoccaggio e di produzione Documentazione conforme alle GMP/cGMP, nonché supporto con audit interni ed esterni gestione, manutenzione e utilizzo sicuro degli strumenti logistici nel rispetto degli standard di sicurezza e qualità rappresentanza del team leader nell'attività quotidiana (flusso dei materiali, definizione delle priorità, escalation) analisi e ottimizzazione dei processi logistici formazione, introduzione e coaching dei dipendenti nei processi logistici il vostro profilo: formazione professionale completata nel settore logistica/magazzinaggio, preferibilmente con ulteriore formazione nella gestione della logistica esperienza professionale pluriennale nel settore della logistica, preferibilmente in un ambiente regolamentato dalle GMP conoscenze di base di cGMP e di esperienza nell'utilizzo di sistemi ERP conoscenza dell'analisi dei processi nonché metodi snelli o di miglioramento continuo buone competenze informatiche e linguistiche in base ai requisiti del ruolo modo di lavorare affidabile, attento e orientato alla qualità elevato livello di indipendenza, forti capacità di problem solving e capacità decisionale La nostra offerta: un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo interno Orari di lavoro flessibili con possibilità di lavorare da casa e possibilità di prendersi giorni di ferie aggiuntivi con un carico di lavoro ridotto Sviluppo dei dipendenti attraverso numerose opportunità di formazione interna ed esterna Copertura del 60% dei contributi alla cassa pensione da parte di Bachem AG as nonché la possibilità della previdenza sovraobbligatoria con il nostro piano di risparmio facoltativo. Una varietà di attività sportive gratuite nel campus di Bachem. Ti piacerebbe guidare l'innovazione insieme a noi? Abbiamo suscitato il tuo interesse? Quindi non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i documenti di candidatura completi tramite il nostro portale di candidatura. Scopri di più sul Gruppo Bachem e lasciati ispirare dal nostro stimolante ambiente di lavoro nella nostra sede di Bubendorf! Non accettiamo candidature da agenzie di reclutamento. Nota: non verranno prese in considerazione le candidature provenienti da agenzie di reclutamento. Inoltrare l'annuncio di lavoro tramite e-mail
descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to drive our continued organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified specialists. To strengthen our team in "Peptide Manufacturing Support" we are looking for a dedicated Senior Production Logistics Technician 100% (m/f/d)
• Your tasks: Ensuring the timely supply of the production lines with materials (raw materials, semi-finished and finished goods) Picking production orders in different storage zones (frozen, chilled, uncooled) Carrying out warehouse movements, rebookings and transfers between storage and production areas GMP/cGMP-compliant documentation as well as support with internal and external audits Operation, maintenance and safe use of logistical tools in compliance with safety and quality standards Representation of the team leader in day-to-day business (material flow, prioritization, escalations) Analysis and optimization of logistics processes Training, induction and coaching of employees in logistics processes
• Your profile: Completed professional training in the area of logistics/warehousing, ideally with further training in logistics management Several years of professional experience in logistics, preferably in a GMP-regulated environment Basic knowledge in cGMP as well as experience in dealing with ERP systems Knowledge of process analysis as well as lean or continuous improvement methods Good IT and language skills according to the requirements of the role Reliable, careful and quality-oriented way of working High level of independence, strong problem-solving skills and decision-making skills Our offer: A dynamic and rapidly growing working environment with internal development opportunities Flexible working hours with the possibility of working from home and the option to take additional vacation days with a reduced workload Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as the option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our optional savings plan. A variety of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus. Would you like to drive innovation together with us? Have we piqued your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal. Find out more about the Bachem Group and be inspired by our inspiring working environment at our location in Bubendorf! We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies. Note: Applications from recruitment agencies will not be considered. Forward the job advertisement by email
