jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the Global IT Department, we are looking for a dedicated SAP Solution Architect (a), 80% - 100%

As part of our SAP Competence Center the SAP Solution Architect is responsible for designing and governing scalable, integrated, and future-ready SAP S/4HANA solutions across pharmaceutical manufacturing and logistics. The role focuses primarily on core business processes in Production, Maintenance, and Quality, ensuring a seamless integration with the Master Data Management System (MDM), Manufacturing Execution System (MES), Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) and other SAP and non-SAP applications. The architect drives modernization through SAP BTP, cloud technologies, and intelligent automation – supporting digital transformation, operational excellence and regulatory compliance across global supply chains.

Your tasks:

• Define and maintain the end-to-end solution architecture, ensuring scalability, security and alignment with enterprise standards

• Design modular, extensible solutions leveraging SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP and modern technologies (e.g. Fiori UX, cloud integration, AI / ML, IoT)

• Lead architecture for manufacturing and logistics processes, ensuring seamless integration across SAP Modules (PP, MM, WM) and compliance with GMP

• Optimize workflows for batch management, serialization, production execution and quality control while maintaining a Clean Core approach.

• Ensure robust integration and interoperability with LIMS, MES and other core systems

• Design compliant solutions adhering to GxP, CFR Part 11, Annex 11, ISO 27001 and support validation, audit readiness and architecture practices

• Drive governance and oversight across program and project lifecycles, securing architectural quality and harmonization across global sites

• Translate business requirements into scalable digital capabilities; facilitate workshops, roadmaps, and cross-functional alignment with senior stakeholders

• Provide thought leadership on modernization, emerging technologies and life science best practices

Your profile:

• Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering or a related field

• 5+ years of experience as an SAP Solution Architect in a regulated manufacturing or life science environment

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP)

• Strong background in designing, implementing and maintaining SAP core manufacturing and logistics modules

• Proven experience in ISA-95 integration frameworks, particularly across MES (Level 3) and ERP (Level 4 / 5) systems

• Strong architectural mindset with deep understanding of end-to-end manufacturing, quality and supply chain processes

• Skilled in balancing compliance and i

Diriger l'architecture pour les processus de fabrication et de logistique, garantissant une intégration transparente entre les modules SAP (PP, MM, WM) et la conformité avec GMP. Optimiser les flux de travail pour la gestion des lots, la sérialisation, l'exécution de la production et le contrôle qualité tout en maintenant un noyau propre. approche. • Votre profil : Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en technologies de l'information, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en tant qu'architecte de solutions SAP dans un environnement de fabrication ou de sciences de la vie réglementé Expérience pratique avec SAP S/4HANA et SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP) Solide expérience dans la conception, la mise en œuvre et la maintenance des modules de fabrication et de logistique de base SAP Expérience avérée dans l'intégration ISA-95 cadres, en particulier dans les systèmes MES (niveau 3) et ERP (niveau 4/5) Forte mentalité architecturale avec une compréhension approfondie des processus de fabrication, de qualité et de chaîne d'approvisionnement de bout en bout.

jobs.description:

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich Supply Chain Europe suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Category Manager Capex (a) 100%, für den Bereich «Bauleistungen» innerhalb der Abteilung Indirect Procurement Europe.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Wahrnehmen der Beschaffungsverantwortung als Fachspezialist für die Erstellung von Planer-, Werk- und Lieferverträgen für neue und Bauprojekte im Bestand in englischer und deutscher Sprache

• Erstellen und Umsetzen von Beschaffungsstrategien unter Berücksichtigung der spezifischen Anforderungen innerhalb der Bauprojekte, regulatorischen Anforderungen und den SIA-Normen

• Vorbereiten, Durchführen und / oder unterstützen von Ausschreibungen inkl. Führung von Vergabegesprächen bis hin zur Vergabe / Beauftragung

• Ausführung und Überwachung des gesamten Beschaffungsprozesses bis hin zur Rechnungskontrolle, sowie allfälliges Nachtragsmanagement

• Laufende Überwachung der operativen und strategischen KPI`s des eigenen Verantwortungsbereiches

• Sicherstellung einer proaktiven Terminüberwachung und Einleiten von Massnahmen zur Sicherstellung von kontrollierten Terminänderungen / Korrekturen

• Sourcing und Evaluation von geeigneten Beschaffungsquellen inkl. Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Lieferantenbeziehungen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern aus den Bereichen Engineering, Produktion, Finanzen und Controlling

• Monitoring, Analyse und Bewertung von Marktentwicklungen, Lieferantenlandschaften und branchenspezifischen Trends

• Weiterentwickeln von Prozessen, Vertragsvorlagen und Systemen innerhalb der bestehenden Systemlandschaft

• Troubleshooting für qualitative oder terminbezogene Problemstellungen

• Mitarbeit in Projekten als Subject Matter Expert für den Bereich Procurement

• Gegenseitige Stellvertretung mi

descriptionByLocale.it: Per favorire la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di specialisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team nell'area Supply Chain Europe, stiamo cercando un Category Manager Capex (f/m/d) 100% dedicato, per l'area “Construction Services” all'interno del dipartimento Indirect Procurement Europe. I vostri compiti: Svolgere la responsabilità degli acquisti come specialista per la preparazione di contratti di pianificazione, lavoro e consegna per progetti di costruzione nuovi ed esistenti in inglese e tedesco. Creazione e implementazione di strategie di procurement, tenendo conto dei requisiti specifici dei progetti di costruzione, dei requisiti normativi e degli standard SIA. Preparazione, esecuzione e/o supporto alle gare d'appalto, inclusa la conduzione delle discussioni sugli appalti fino all'aggiudicazione/messa in servizio. Esecuzione e monitoraggio dell'intero processo di approvvigionamento fino al controllo delle fatture e dell'eventuale gestione supplementare Monitoraggio continuo dei KPI operativi e strategici della propria area di responsabilità Garantire il monitoraggio proattivo delle scadenze e l'avvio di misure per garantire modifiche/correzioni controllate delle scadenze Approvvigionamento e valutazione di fonti di approvvigionamento adeguate, compresa l'instaurazione e il mantenimento di rapporti con i fornitori a lungo termine Stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni dei settori ingegneria, produzione, finanza e controllo Monitoraggio, analisi e valutazione degli sviluppi del mercato, del panorama dei fornitori e delle tendenze specifiche del settore Ulteriori informazioni sviluppo di processi, modelli contrattuali e sistemi nell'ambito del panorama sistemico esistente risoluzione dei problemi qualitativi o legati alle scadenze partecipazione a progetti in qualità di esperto in materia per l'area degli appalti rappresentanza reciproca
descriptionByLocale.en:

Dabei arbeiten Sie unter GMP-Bedingungen und setzen von der Herstellung bis zur Aufreinigung moderne Produktionsanlagen ein. Über die praxisorientierte Einarbeitung werden Sie die notwendige Sicherheit gewinnen, selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich an unseren Produktionsanlagen zu arbeiten und ein Teil unseres Teams werden. • Sie steuern, überwachen und beobachten unsere Herstellungsprozesse und dokumentieren GMP-gerecht.

• Sie kontrollieren die Chargen-Dokumentation.

• Sie helfen bei der Qualifizierung des Produktionsequipments.

• Sie bereiten In-Prozess-Kontrollen und Musterzüge vor und führen diese selbst durch.

• Sie führen Reinigungs- und Wartungsarbeiten sowie einfache Instandsetzungstätigkeiten an den Produktionsanlagen aus.

• Sie bereiten Herstellungskampagnen vor. Dafür stellen Sie Ausrüstung, Lösungsmittel und Ausgangsstoffe in den jeweiligen Produktionsräumen bereit und kontrollieren die Apparate und Anlagen.

• Sie arbeiten aktiv und selbstständig an der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produktionsanlagen und Arbeitsabläufe mit.

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemikant, Chemielaborant oder einer gleichwertigen Ausbildung bzw. Chemie- und Pharmatechnologe

• Bereitschaft für Schichtarbeit (Früh- und Spätschicht) Kein 6/4 -oder Nachtschichtmodell

• Vorliebe zur Arbeit und Dokumentation nach GMP-Vorgaben sowie Erfahrung im GMP-Umfeld von Vorteil

• Erfahrung mit Tätigkeiten im Reinraum sind erwünscht

• Ausgeprägte Zuverlässigkeit und Selbstständigkeit

• Eine strukturierte und saubere und selbständige Arbeitsweise, die es Ihnen erlaubt, jederzeit den Überblick zu behalten

• Flexibilität, Kommunikation und Lernbereitschaft gehören zu Ihren Stärken

• Sie zeichnen sich durch ein hohes Mass an Zuverlässigkeit, Selbständigkeit und Teamfähigkeit aus

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift </sp

Per potenziare il nostro reparto di produzione principi attivi ricerchiamo un tecnologo/chimico chimico e farmaceutico (f/m/d) motivato. Nel nostro impianto di produzione producete oligonucleotidi farmaceuticamente efficaci e sostanze correlate. Lavori in condizioni GMP e utilizzi moderni sistemi di produzione dalla produzione alla purificazione. Attraverso la formazione orientata alla pratica, acquisirai la sicurezza necessaria per lavorare in modo indipendente e responsabile sui nostri sistemi di produzione e diventare parte del nostro team. Se per te è importante lavorare con noi oltre il tuo lavoro quotidiano per migliorare continuamente i nostri impianti di produzione e i nostri processi lavorativi e apprezzi l'opportunità di contribuire a modellare le tue condizioni di lavoro in questo modo, allora sei nel posto giusto.
• I tuoi compiti: controlli, monitori e osservi i nostri processi di produzione e li documenti in conformità con GMP. Controlli la documentazione del batch. Aiutano a qualificare le attrezzature di produzione. Prepari controlli e campioni durante il processo e li esegui tu stesso. Insieme ai capigruppo responsabili prendete decisioni per l'ulteriore svolgimento della produzione, ad esempio sulla base di controlli in-process. Eseguite lavori di pulizia e manutenzione nonché semplici lavori di riparazione sugli impianti di produzione. Stanno preparando campagne di produzione. Per fare ciò, fornite attrezzature, solventi e materie prime nei rispettivi locali di produzione e controllate le attrezzature e gli impianti. Lavorerai attivamente e in modo indipendente al miglioramento costante dei nostri impianti produttivi e dei processi lavorativi. descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to drive our continued organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified specialists. To strengthen our active ingredient production department, we are looking for a motivated chemical and pharmaceutical technologist/chemist (f/m/d). In our production facility you produce pharmaceutically effective oligonucleotides and related substances. You work under GMP conditions and use modern production systems from production to purification. Through the practice-oriented training, you will gain the necessary confidence to work independently and responsibly on our production systems and become part of our team. If it is important to you to work with us beyond your daily work to continually improve our production facilities and work processes and you value the opportunity to help shape your working conditions in this way, then you have come to the right place.
• Your tasks: You control, monitor and observe our manufacturing processes and document them in accordance with GMP. You check the batch documentation. They help qualify the production equipment. You prepare in-process controls and samples and carry them out yourself. Together with the responsible group leaders, you make decisions for the further course of production, for example based on in-process controls. You carry out cleaning and maintenance work as well as simple repair work on the production facilities. They are preparing manufacturing campaigns. To do this, you provide equipment, solvents and raw materials in the respective production rooms and check the equipment and systems. You will work actively and independently on the constant improvement of our production facilities and work processes.
• Your profile: Completed training as a chemical technician, chemical laboratory technician or an equivalent training or chemical and pharmaceutical technologist Willingness for shift work (early and late shift) No 6/4 or night shift model Preference for working and documenting according to GMP specifications as well as experience in the GMP environment is an advantage Experience with work in a clean room is desired Strong reliability and independence A structured and clean and independent way of working that allows you to keep an overview at all times Flexibility, communication and Willingness to learn is one of your strengths You are characterized by a high degree of reliability, independence and ability to work in a team Very good knowledge of spoken and written German </sp

jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the GSCM Network & Demand Center, we are looking for a dedicated Director S&OP and Network Strategy (a), 100%.

Your tasks:

• Lead, manage and continuously develop the GSCM Network & Demand Center organization in line with the strategic objectives of the division, encompassing Quality, Safety, People, Innovation, Sustainability, Customer Centricity and Operational Excellence, as well as Bachem’s leadership principles.

• Own and drive the forecast-to-plan process, ensuring continuous end to end transparency of demand, inventory and supply scenarios across the entire Bachem Group.

• Accountable for the end-to-end global Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, leading its preparation, execution, and follow-up to secure alignment between commercial, operational, and financial targets

• Accountable for global supply chain network design and implementation for new products, and the continuous development of existing networks through strategic partnerships

• Lead the global product lifecycle management process (SKU level), including preparation and execution of make-or-buy decisions and end to end inventory management.

• Act as a key point of contact for internal and external customers within the Bachem Group and represent the GSCM organization in internal and external committees and forums.

• Ensure timely and accurate handling of customer requests in close collaboration with the regional supply organizations.

• Lead cross-functional projects to enhance supply chain performance, resilience, and efficiency.

• Assume full budget and cost center responsibility for the assigned organizational unit.

Your profile:

• Technical or commercial education at university level (FH/University)

• Advanced education in Supply Chain Management, ideally including an APICS certification.

• Experience in leading teams, including direct line management as well as leadership within matrix and cross functional organizations, with the ability to develop, coach and empower people, foster collaboration and create an environment where teams can grow and succeed together.

• Strong end to end understanding of supply chain processes (planning, procurement, manufacturing, distribution and finance).

• Excellent cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align diverse interests in a complex, global organization.

• Strong executive-level communication skills, including presentation, negotiation, conflict management and resolution.

• Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken.

jobs.description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Produktion von Wirkstoffen suchen wir nach Vereinbarung einen Schichtleiter (Chemikant, Pharmakant, Chemie- und Pharmatechnologe oder vergleichbare Ausbildung) im Schichtbetrieb (a) 6/4, Früh-/Spät-/Nachtschicht.

Wir bieten Ihnen ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabenspektrum in der Herstellung von pharmazeutisch Wirkstoffen.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie führen ein Schichtteam. Dabei übernehmen Sie das operative Management auf Ihrer Schicht und stellen mit ihrem Team die Produktionssicherheit, und Qualität sicher.

• Sie sind Linienvorgesetzter der Operatoren Ihres Schichtteams und Ihnen obliegt die zugehörige Personalverantwortung. Sie setzen die Mitarbeiter nach ihrem Kenntnisstand ein und stellen sicher, dass der Produktionsplan erfüllt wird.

• Sie bereiten Herstellungskampagnen vor. Dafür rüsten sie Ausgangsstoffe im SAP und stellen sicher, dass diese bedarfsgerecht zur Verfügung stehen. Sie kontrollieren die Produktionsräume, Apparate und Anlagen hinsichtlich Sicherheit und GMP Compliance und stellen deren Verfügbarkeit sicher.

• Sie sorgen für einen korrekten Informationsfluss bis zu jedem Mitarbeiter oder zurück zum Produktionsleiter und kommunizieren mit verschiedenen Abteilungen bei Verbesserungen und Korrekturen (Beispiel mit der Abteilung Technik)

• Sie und Ihr Schichtteam arbeiten in Reinräumen und Laboren und führen Aufgaben mit Lyophilisatoren und anderem Equipment durch.

• Sie und Ihr Team steuern, überwachen, beobachten und protokollieren gewissenhaft den Herstellungsprozess nach den gültigen HSE- und GMP-Vorgaben. Dabei stellen sie sowohl Kampagnenvor- und Nachbereitung in der Produktion sicher (Schulungen und Kontrolle der GMP-gerechten Produktion eines Batchs)

• Sie treffen Entscheide für den weiteren Produktionsverlauf (z.B. anhand von In-Prozess-Kontrollen und Analysendaten)

• Sie kontrollieren sowohl die Batchdokumentation bzw. digitale Dokumentation als auch die zugehörigen Logbucheinträge und sorgen für deren sorgfältige Bearbeitung

• Sie arbeiten aktiv an der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produktionsanlagen und Arbeitsabläufe mit und initiieren und unterstützen Verbesserung von Herstellprozessen

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemikant, Pharmakant, Chemie- und Pharmatechnologe oder vergleichbare Ausbildung und mehrjährige Erfahrung im Produktionsbereich

• Eine Weiterbildung im Chemisch- Pharmazeutischen Bereich z.B. Industriemeister bzw. Techniker oder vergleichbare Qualifikation ist vorteilhaft

• Ausgeprägtes Gespür für Menschen und sehr gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten (idealerweise bereits Erfahrung in der Personalführung)

• Fundierte GMP-Kenntnisse im Produktionsumfeld und der Prozessdokumentation

• Erfahrung in Reinraumumgebungen und in der Handhabung hochaktiver Wirkstoffe

• Sie sind ein Organisationstalent und in der Lage Mitarbeiter motiviert zu führen

• Sie haben eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, die es Ihnen erlaubt, jederzeit den Überblick zu be

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per rafforzare il nostro team nella produzione di principi attivi, cerchiamo un capoturno (chimico, tecnico farmaceutico, tecnico chimico e farmaceutico o formazione comparabile) previo accordo nell'operazione di turno (a) 6/4, turno presto/tarda/notturno. Vi offriamo una vasta gamma di compiti nella produzione di principi attivi farmaceutici.
• I tuoi compiti Dirigi una squadra di turno. Assumerai la gestione operativa durante il tuo turno e garantirai la sicurezza e la qualità della produzione con il tuo team. Sei il manager di linea degli operatori della tua squadra di turno e sei responsabile della responsabilità del personale associato. Assegnano i dipendenti in base al loro livello di conoscenza e garantiscono il rispetto del piano di produzione. Stanno preparando campagne di produzione. Per fare ciò, preparano le materie prime in SAP e si assicurano che siano disponibili secondo necessità. Controllate i locali di produzione, le attrezzature e i sistemi per quanto riguarda la sicurezza e la conformità GMP e ne assicurate la disponibilità. Garantisci un corretto flusso di informazioni a ciascun dipendente o al responsabile della produzione e comunichi con i vari reparti per miglioramenti e correzioni (ad esempio con il dipartimento tecnologico). Tu e il tuo team di turno lavorate in camere bianche e laboratori e svolgete attività con liofilizzatori e altre apparecchiature. Tu e il tuo team controllate, monitorate, osservate e registrate attentamente il processo di produzione in conformità con le specifiche HSE e GMP applicabili. Garantiscono sia la preparazione della campagna che il follow-up della produzione (formazione e controllo della produzione di un lotto conforme alle GMP). Prendono decisioni per l'ulteriore corso della produzione (ad es. sulla base di controlli durante il processo e dati di analisi) Controllate sia la documentazione dei lotti o la documentazione digitale, sia le relative registrazioni del registro e assicurate la loro attenta elaborazione Lavorate attivamente al miglioramento costante dei nostri impianti di produzione e dei processi di lavoro e avviate e sostenete il miglioramento dei processi di produzione Il vostro profilo Formazione completata come tecnico chimico, tecnico farmaceutico, tecnologo chimico e farmaceutico o formazione comparabile e pluriennale esperienza nel settore della produzione Ulteriore formazione nel settore chimico e farmaceutico, ad es. caposquadra o tecnico industriale o qualifica comparabile è vantaggiosa. Un forte senso delle persone e ottime capacità di comunicazione (idealmente, precedente esperienza nella gestione del personale). Conoscenza approfondita delle GMP nell'ambiente di produzione e nella documentazione del processo. Esperienza in ambienti clean room e nella manipolazione di sostanze altamente attive. Hai talento organizzativo e sei in grado di guidare i dipendenti in modo motivato. Hai un modo di lavorare strutturato che ti consente di avere sempre una visione d'insieme
descriptionByLocale.en:
To strengthen our team in the production of active ingredients, we are looking for a shift manager (chemist, pharmaceutical technician, chemical and pharmaceutical technologist or comparable training) by arrangement in shift operation (a) 6/4, early/late/night shift.
• We offer you a varied range of tasks in the production of active pharmaceutical ingredients.
• Your tasks You lead a shift team. You will take over operational management on your shift and ensure production safety and quality with your team. You are the line manager of the operators in your shift team and you are responsible for the associated personnel responsibility. They deploy employees according to their level of knowledge and ensure that the production plan is met. They are preparing manufacturing campaigns. To do this, they prepare raw materials in SAP and ensure that they are available as needed. You control the production rooms, equipment and systems with regard to safety and GMP compliance and ensure their availability. You ensure a correct flow of information to each employee or back to the production manager and communicate with various departments for improvements and corrections (example with the technology department). You and your shift team work in clean rooms and laboratories and carry out tasks with lyophilizers and other equipment. You and your team carefully control, monitor, observe and record the manufacturing process in accordance with the applicable HSE and GMP specifications. They ensure both campaign preparation and follow-up in production (training and control of GMP-compliant production of a batch). They make decisions for the further course of production (e.g. based on in-process controls and analysis data) You control both the batch documentation or digital documentation as well as the associated logbook entries and ensure their careful processing You actively work on the constant improvement of our production facilities and work processes and initiate and support improvement of manufacturing processes
• Your profile Completed training as a chemical technician, pharmaceutical technician, chemical and pharmaceutical technologist or comparable training and several years of experience in the production area Further training in the chemical and pharmaceutical sector, e.g. industrial foreman or technician or comparable qualification is advantageous. A strong sense of people and very good communication skills (ideally, previous experience in personnel management). Sound GMP knowledge in the production environment and process documentation. Experience in clean room environments and in the handling of highly active substances. You have organizational talent and are able to lead employees in a motivated manner. You have a structured way of working that allows you to keep an overview at all times

jobs.description:
Bachem is a leading, innovation-driven company specializing in the development and manufacture of peptides and oligonucleotides. With over 50 years of experience and expertise Bachem provides products for research, clinical development and commercial application to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies worldwide and offers a comprehensive range of services. Bachem operates internationally with headquarters in Switzerland and locations in Europe, the US and Asia. The company is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange. For further information, see www.bachem.com.

As  Automation Engineer  /  Project Engineer  for the  Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab 100% (m/w/d) , you will play a central role in building, operating, and advancing our laboratory environment for digital manufacturing solutions. You will combine expertise in process automation, simulation, and lab infrastructure to enable engineers, data scientists, and developers to design, test, and deploy innovative solutions.

With a strong focus on PCS7-based automation systems, SIMIT simulations, and lab infrastructure, you will act as a technical allrounder bridging automation, IT/OT development systems, and user enablement. Your work will directly support experimentation, prototyping, and scaling of digital and automation solutions across TechOps and manufacturing.

Your Tasks:

• Design, implement, and maintain the Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab infrastructure, including automation systems, virtualized environments, and network setups

• Develop, configure, and support Siemens PCS7 systems (incl. WinCC, Simatic Batch) for lab and pilot environments

• Build and maintain simulation capabilities and digital twins using SIMIT, enabling virtual commissioning, testing, and training scenarios

• Administer and operate lab IT/OT infrastructure, including virtualization, systems, and network components

• Integrate controllers, field devices, and lab equipment into cohesive automation and data environments

• Provide and maintain internal tools, templates, and automation libraries for users of the lab

• Support users (engineers, data scientists) in utilizing lab systems for experiments, testing, and troubleshooting

• Participate in automation and digitalization projects, from requirements gathering to prototyping and implementation

• Maintain system documentation, ensure configuration management, and support testing activities where applicable

• Identify opportunities to improve the lab environment and introduce new technologies and best practices

Your Profile:

• University degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field

• Hands-on experience with process control systems, ideally Siemens PCS7, WinCC, and Simatic Batch, as well as simulation tools such as SIMIT or similar platforms

• Solid understanding of automation hardware, PLCs, controllers, field instrumentation, system integration, and industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus)

• Practical knowledge of IT/OT infrastructure, including virtualization, Windows administration, TCP/IP networking, virtual environments (e.g., VMware, Proxmox), and network segmentation in lab setups

• Exposure to data systems (e.g., historians, MES, analytics platforms), their integration with automation systems, and experience in virtual commissioning and digital twin approaches

• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work across disciplines, act as a technical allrounder, and translate user needs into practical technical solutions

• Dedicated, self-driven, structured, and collaborative personality with a hands-on mindset; solid knowledge of German is considered a strong plus

À propos de Bachem

Bachem est une entreprise leader et innovante spécialisée dans le développement et la fabrication de peptides et de oligonucléotides. Avec plus de 50 ans d'expérience et d'expertise, Bachem fournit des produits de recherche, de développement clinique et d'application commerciale aux entreprises pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologie dans le monde entier et offre une gamme complète de services. Bachem opère à l'international avec son siège en Suisse et des sites en Europe, aux États-Unis et en Asie.

Emplacement

En tant qu'ingénieur d'automatisation / ingénieur de projet pour le Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab 100% (m/w/d), vous jouerez un rôle central dans la construction, l'exploitation et la promotion de notre environnement de laboratoire pour les solutions de fabrication numériques. Vous combinerez expertise en automatisation de processus, simulation et infrastructure de lab pour permettre aux ingénieurs, aux data savants et aux développeurs de concevoir, tester et déployer des solutions innovantes.

Avec un accent particulier sur les systèmes d'automatisation basés sur PCS7, les simulations SIMIT et l'infrastructure de lab, vous agirez comme une automatisation de passerelle polyvalente technique, les systèmes de développement IT/OT et les utilisateurs en l'an 2013. Votre travail soutiendra directement l'expérimentation, le prototypage et l'échelle des solutions numériques et d'automatisation dans TechOps et dans la fabrication.

Responsabilités

- Conception, mise en œuvre et entretien de l'infrastructure Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab, y compris les systèmes d'automatisation, les environnements virtualisés et les configurations réseau - Développement, configuration et support des systèmes Siemens PCS7 (incl.

WinCC, Simatic Batch) pour les environnements lab et pilotes - Créer et maintenir des capacités de simulation et des jumelles numériques à l'aide de SIMIT, permettant la mise en service, l'essai et la formation virtuelles - Administrer et exploiter l'infrastructure de lab IT/OT, y compris la virtualisation, les systèmes et les composants de réseau - Intégrer les contrôleurs, les dispositifs de terrain et l'équipement de lab dans des environnements d'automatisation et de données cohérents - Fournir et maintenir des outils internes, des modèles et des bibliothèques d'automatisation pour les utilisateurs de lab - Aider les utilisateurs (ingénieurs, data savants) à utiliser les systèmes de lab pour des expériences, des essais,

et dépannage - Participer à des projets d'automatisation et de numérisation, de la collecte des exigences à la mise en oeuvre et au prototypage - Maintenir la documentation du système, assurer la gestion de la configuration et appuyer les activités de test, le cas échéant - Identifier les possibilités d'améliorer l'environnement de la lab et d'introduire de nouvelles technologies et de nouvelles pratiques exemplaires

Besoins

- Diplôme universitaire en ingénierie d'automatisation, génie électrique, informatique ou un domaine technique connexe - Expérience pratique avec les systèmes de contrôle de processus, idéalement Siemens PCS7, WinCC et Simatic Batch, ainsi que des outils de simulation tels que SIMIT ou des plateformes similaires - Connaissance solide du matériel d'automatisation, des PLC, des contrôleurs, de l'instrumentation de terrain, de l'intégration des systèmes et des protocoles de communication industrielle (par exemple OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus) - Connaissance pratique de l'infrastructure IT/OT, y compris la virtualisation, l'administration Windows, le réseau TCP/IP, les environnements virtuels

(p. ex., VMware, Proxmox) et segmentation de réseau dans les configurations de lab - Exposition aux systèmes de données (p. ex., historiens, MES, plateformes d'analyse), leur intégration aux systèmes d'automatisation, et expérience dans la mise en service virtuelle et les approches numériques jumelées - Fortes compétences en résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de travailler dans les disciplines, d'agir comme un tout technique, et de traduire les besoins des utilisateurs en solutions techniques pratiques - Personnalité dédiée, auto-didacte, structurée et collaborative avec un état d'esprit pratique; une connaissance solide de l'allemand est considérée comme un plus

jobs.title: Senior Process Automation Engineer (DSP) (a), 100%

titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur principal d'automatisation des processus (DSP) (f/m/j), 100%

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of our long-term strategy to expand production capacity. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals.

For this large-scale CAPEX investment project, we are seeking an experienced Senior Process Automation Engineer (f/m/d) with a focus on downstream processing automation .

Your tasks:

• You are a technical expert (SME) for process automation (DSP) within a major CAPEX project (> CHF 100 million)

• Design, develop, and implement automation solutions (Level 0–2.5) for downstream unit operations:

• Chromatography

• Filtration (UF/DF, TFF)

• Purification processes

• Translate process requirements into automation concepts, batch logic and control strategies

• Review and optimize automation designs and system architectures in collaboration with external partners

• Integrate systems into the overall automation landscape (DCS, PLC, MES, Historian)

• Ensure compliance with GMP, GAMP5, data integrity and validation requirements

• Coordinate and lead external engineering firms, system integrators and contractors

• Collaborate closely with Engineering, MSAT, IT/OT, and Quality

• Support the project from concept phase through commissioning, qualification, and handover

• Contribute to standardization and development of automation concepts for the new site

• Ensure delivery in terms of quality, budget, and timeline

Your profile:

• Degree in automation, chemical engineering, biotechnology or a related field

• At least 8–10 years of experience in automation within pharmaceutical or biotech environments

• Strong expertise in:

• Downstream process automation (chromatography, filtration, purification)

• DCS system (Siemens PCS7, PCSneo), PLC (e.g. Siemens TIA Portal), SCADA (WinCC) and batch control

• Experience with MES, historian and data/PAT integration

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a dedicated MES System Engineer (a), 80 - 100%.

Your Tasks:

• Lead the full lifecycle management of the Körber PAS-X Manufacturing Execution System (MES), including solution design, configuration, deployment, validation, maintenance, and continuous improvement

• Support the design and implementation of next-generation MES architectures aligned with smart manufacturing, digital plant strategies, and Pharma 4.0 initiatives

• Drive MES activities across the new facility startup lifecycle, from project design and commissioning through qualification, go-live, and commercial manufacturing operations

• Collaborate with manufacturing, automation, IT/OT, quality, engineering, and global digital teams to define and implement scalable PAS-X solutions

• Translate business and manufacturing process requirements into robust MES functional and technical designs

• Ensure high system availability, reliability, and performance for GMP-regulated manufacturing environments, including on-call and operational support where required

• Manage change control, deviation investigations, incident management, and problem resolution in close collaboration with IT, operations, and system vendors

• Support integration of PAS-X with enterprise and shopfloor systems including ERP, LIMS, Historians, Automation and integration platforms

• Contribute to MES platform standardization, template strategies, and deployment methodologies across global manufacturing sites

• Maintain GMP-compliant documentation throughout the system lifecycle, including specifications, risk assessments, validation deliverables, and operational procedures

• Act as MES Subject Matter Expert (SME) during audits, inspections, qualification activities, and regulatory interactions

• Support commissioning, qualification, and computerized system validation (CSV/CSA) activities in accordance with GAMP5 and data integrity requirements

Your Profile:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Automation Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Pharmaceutical Engineering, or a related technical discipline

• 4 – 6 years of strong hands-on experience with Körber PAS-X MES in regulated pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturing environments

• Proven experience supporting MES implementation projects for new manufacturing facilities, site expansions, or large-scale digital transformation programs

• Solid understanding of next-generation MES/IT-OT architectures, system integrations, and smart factory concepts

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group plans a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland as part of its long-term strategy to significantly expand production capacity. The new site will play a central role in supporting Bachem’s growth ambitions in peptide manufacturing.

To strengthen our Global Engineering organization, we are looking for a Senior Project Manager who will take full accountability for the successful delivery of large and complex CAPEX projects and build high-performing project teams from early concept through to operational readiness.

• Overall project responsibility
Take full accountability for large-scale CAPEX projects (>100 MCHF) across all project phases – from feasibility and concept studies through execution, commissioning, qualification and handover to operations

• Building and leading high-performing teams
Establish, onboard and lead multidisciplinary project teams; define clear roles, responsibilities and ways of working, and ensure effective collaboration across all project participants

• Owner’s project leadership and governance
Act as the Owner’s representative ensuring that project design and execution meets defined objectives (scope, functionality, capacity, cost, schedule, quality, safety and sustainability)
Drive governance processes including project charters, business cases, URS/URB inputs, and structured decision-making in alignment with Steering Committees

• Stakeholder alignment and integration
Align and integrate all key stakeholders (User, QA, SHE, Manufacturing IT, Finance) into one high-performing project team and ensure transparent communication and collaboration

• Execution strategy and partner management
Define and manage appropriate project delivery models (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) from an Owner’s perspective and lead external engineering partners, contractors and suppliers

• Project controls and performance management
Implement and ensure robust project controls (scope, schedule, cost, risk, change management) including structured reporting and forecasting (PMR) to senior management

• Compliance and regulatory excellence
Ensure compliance with GMP requirements, corporate standards, local regulations and building codes across all project phases

• Commissioning and operational readiness
Lead commissioning, qualification and start-up activities and ensure a smooth transition to operations including post-handover support (“hypercare”) to achieve stable and reliable performance

• Leadership in decision-making and problem solving
Identify, challenge and evaluate alternatives, drive decision-making and proactively resolve critical project issues in close alignment with the Steering Committee

Your Profile

• University degree (MSc / BSc) in Engineering, Construction or related discipline

• Minimum 10 years of experience in managing large capital projects in an industrial, preferably GMP-regulated environment

• Proven track record in leading complex CAPEX

Take full accountability for large-scale CAPEX projects (>100 MCHF) across all project phases – from feasibility and concept studies through execution, commissioning, qualification and handover to operations

• Building and leading high-performing teams
Establish, onboard and lead multidisciplinary project teams; define clear roles, responsibilities and ways of working, and ensure effective collaboration across all project participants

• Owner’s project leadership and governance
Act as the Owner’s representative ensuring that project design and execution meets defined objectives (scope, functionality, capacity, cost, schedule, quality, safety and sustainability)
Drive governance processes including project charters, business cases, URS/URB inputs, and structured decision-making in alignment with Steering Committees

• Stakeholder alignment and integration
Align and integrate all key stakeholders (User, QA, SHE, Manufacturing IT, Finance) into one high-performing project team and ensure transparent communication and collaboration

• Execution strategy and partner management
Define and manage appropriate project delivery models (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) from an Owner’s perspective and lead external engineering partners, contractors and suppliers

• Project controls and performance management
Implement and ensure robust project controls (scope, schedule, cost, risk, change management) including structured reporting and forecasting (PMR) to senior management

• Compliance and regulatory excellence
Ensure compliance with GMP requirements, corporate standards, local regulations and building codes across all project phases

• Commissioning and operational readiness
Lead commissioning, qualification and start-up activities and ensure a smooth transition to operations including post-handover support (“hypercare”) to achieve stable and reliable performance

• Proven track record in leading complex CAPEX

jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a dedicated IT Service Delivery Manager (a), 80-100%

Your tasks:

• Own core ITSM processes — Lead Incident, Problem, Configuration and Event Management globally, ensuring SLA compliance and alignment with SOPs/ITIL.

• Define performance metrics — Set KPIs/SLAs, build dashboards, deliver monthly reports and manage escalations

• Maintain process documentation — Create and update SOPs, training materials and ensure role clarity with tracked training records

• Drive Problem Management — Run RCA processes, remediation follow‑up, stakeholder communication and proactive risk identification

• Manage Known Errors — Maintain Key Issue databases and ensure workarounds are documented and shared

• Lead CMDB governance — Own CMDB strategy, CI lifecycle accuracy, data models and service dependency mapping

• Ensure CMDB data quality — Perform audits, reconciliation, issue resolution and integration with change/incident/monitoring processes

• Optimize CMDB tooling — Enhance CMDB/asset platform usage, automate via discovery tools and report on configuration compliance

• Run Event Management — Ensure monitoring coverage, correct event filtering/correlation and impact‑based escalation

• Define event automation — Maintain thresholds, notifications and automated/self‑healing responses

Your profile:

• 7+ years in IT Operations, Service Management or a related technical field, including Service Operations or Service Delivery Management

• Hands-on experience in Incident, Problem, Configuration and/or Event Management; Major Incident Management is an advantage

• ITIL Foundation certification required; ITIL Intermediate/Expert an asset.

• Strong cross-domain technical expertise across infrastructure, applications, databases, and security, with a deep understanding of their interdependencies—including modern workplace devices, application servers, and backend platforms

• Strong analytical skills to identify patterns, correlations and root causes, with the ability to lead technical RCA calls

• Excellent communication skills, translating technical detail into business- and user-friendly language

• Strong facilitation and leadership under pressure, with the ability to work across global teams and manage stakeholders at all levels

• Experience with monitoring, log analysis and service management platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, LogicMonitor).

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Wirkstoffproduktion suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Lab Technician R&D (a), 100%.

In unseren R&D-Laboren forschen Sie an der Prozessentwicklung von pharmazeutischen Peptiden unter nonGMP-Bedienungen für LPPS oder TAPS Produktionsverfahren. Über die praxisorientierte Einarbeitung werden Sie die notwendige Sicherheit gewinnen, um selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich in unseren Forschungslaboren zu arbeiten. Dabei packen Sie gerne tatkräftig mit an und haben Freude an abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben.

• Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Laborversuchen

• Entwickeln und optimieren des Herstellprozesses von der Synthese über die Aufreinigung bis zum finalen Wirkstoff sowie die Herstellung von Peptiden

• Verantwortung für die Analyse der Experimente und Interpretation von Ergebnissen

• Aktive Mitarbeit an der Verbesserung unseres Equipments und der Arbeitsabläufe sowie Unterhalt der Laborinfrastruktur

• lnvolvierung in Scale-up Projekte und Optimierung des Herstellungsverfahrens sowie Bewertung neuer Technologien und Reagenzien

• Sicherstellung einer sauberen Dokumentation

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemielaborant (EFZ) oder vergleichbare Ausbildung oder Berufserfahrung

• Freude an der präparativen organischen Chemie in einem innovativen Umfeld

• Flair für den Umgang mit technischen Anlagen und Software

• Eine strukturierte, saubere und selbstständige Arbeitsweise

• Flexibilität, Kommunikation und Lernbereitschaft

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. For our Group Intellectual Property team in Bubendorf/BL, we are seeking a highly skilled Patent Counsel (a), 80 – 100% . To support and protect our innovation-driven business, the Group Intellectual Property plays a pivotal role in securing competitive advantages, supporting technological progress, and creating long-term value across the organization.

In this highly visible role, you will work closely with scientists, R&D teams, and business stakeholders across the organization. Your responsibilities will span the full spectrum of intellectual property activities, including invention harvesting, patent drafting, and global patent prosecution. In addition, you will serve as a trusted advisor on IP-related matters, providing practical and business-oriented guidance to internal partners and helping to shape the company's innovation strategy in a dynamic and rapidly growing environment. Patent Counsel – Shape the Future of Innovation at Bachem

Your tasks:

• Collaborate with inventors, engineers, and scientists to identify potentially patentable inventions

• Conduct patentability searches

• Provide strategic advice on optimal protection routes

• Guide inventors in documenting inventions and preparing high-quality invention disclosures

• Draft, file, and prosecute patent applications to secure and maintain IP protection worldwide

• Manage and instruct external patent counsel as appropriate

• Instruct and supervise FTO searches

• Conduct freedom-to-operate (FTO) analyses and assess third-party rights.

• Advice on infringement risks and measures for risk mitigation.

• Draft contractual positions and advice on IP related matters

Your profile:

• Qualification as a European Patent Attorney

• A strong scientific background in chemistry or a closely related discipline

• Proven experience in patent prosecution

• Experience in reviewing, drafting, and negotiating IP-related agreements

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail

• Team player with the ability to perform effectively in a dynamic environment

• Excellent communication skills in English and German

jobs.description:
To strengthen our team in the Global IT department, we are looking for a dedicated DevOps Platform Engineer, 100%.

We are building an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that lets teams across Bachem deliver applications in a standardized, self-service way. In this hands-on role you will build, operate and scale the platform – bringing your experience to strengthen its core foundations today, and helping grow it into the backbone that serves the whole organization tomorrow.

Your tasks:

• Build, automate and operate our Internal Developer Platform based on GitHub Enterprise and cloud infrastructure

• Design and maintain infrastructure as code to provision environments, resources and guardrails in a repeatable, auditable way

• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and reusable workflow templates in GitHub Actions, with quality, security and compliance built in

• Help scale the platform as adoption grows - improving reusable templates, guardrails and self-service capabilities so it serves more teams without more manual effort

• Keep the platform reliable, compliant and secure – monitoring, observability, incident response, patching and continuous improvement of operational practices

• Implement platform governance and guardrails: access management, policies, secrets handling and cost awareness

• Facilitate discussions and drive alignment across stakeholder groups with different priorities, translating their requirements into coherent, shared platform capabilities.

• Partner with developers across a wide range of skill levels: coaching newcomers, enabling professional developers and adapting your communication and support to each audience.

• Create documentation, guidelines and onboarding materials that make the platform easy to adopt for developers of every maturity level

• Collaborate closely with the Platform Owner to translate the platform roadmap into technical solutions

• Ensure platform reliability and security through monitoring, observability, and policy-driven governance

Your profile

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Forschung & Entwicklung suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n  Scientist Peptidwirkstoffe R&D LPPS/TAPS (w/m/d), 100%. Das Arbeitsgebiet umfasst zahlreiche unterschiedliche Schritte der modernen Synthese von peptidischen Wirkstoffen, Peptidfragmenten und Aminosäurebausteinen in Lösung, sowie diverse Technologien zur Aufkonzentration und Isolation der Produkte.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Verantwortung für die Planung, Analyse und Interpretation von Experimenten sowie die Darstellung der erhaltenen Ergebnisse

• Planung und zeitgerechte Durchführung von Entwicklungsarbeiten bzw. Prozessoptimierungen in Kooperation mit anderen Abteilungen unter Berücksichtigung von Qualität, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Sicherheit

• Durchführung von Prozesstransfers (Scale-up) und Unterstützung der Produktion bei Einführung neuer Prozesse, z.T. unter cGMP-Richtlinien

• Fokus auf den LPPS/TAPS-Bereich (Organische Chemie in Lösung, Peptidkupplungen, Schutzgruppenchemie, Extraktion, Fällung, Kristalisation)

• Verfassen von Berichten und Erstellen von Präsentationen zu den durchgeführten Arbeiten für interne und externe Kunden

• Unterstützung der Produktion beim Lösen von chemischen Herausforderungen (Troubleshooting)

• Aktive Beteiligung an der ständigen Verbesserung unseres Equipments und der Arbeitsabläufe sowie Unterhalt der Laborinfrastruktur

Ihr Profil:

• Promotion in Chemie

• Erfahrungen in der präparativen organischen Synthese und ein Faible für Prozesstechnik

• Eine strukturierte, genaue und selbstständige Arbeitsweise, die es Ihnen erlaubt, jederzeit den Überblick zu behalten

• Ausgeprägte kommunikative und organisatorische Fähigkeiten

• Zuverlässigkeit, Selbstständigkeit und Teamfähigkeit

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Kenntnisse in Peptidchemie und gängigen Analysetechniken wie UHPLC und LC-MS sind von Vorteil

Unser Angebot:

• Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung mit Möglichkeit für Home-Office und Option zum Bezug zusätzlicher Ferientage mit reduziertem Arbeitspensum

• Mitarbeiterförderung durch zahlreiche interne und externe Weiterbildungsangebote

• 60%-ige Übernahme der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem AG sowie Möglichkeit für überobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Wahlsparplan

• Zugang zu Vorteilsplattform mit Rabatten bei externen Partnern

• Frisches, gesundes und vielfältiges Essen in unserem Personalrestaurant

• Vielfältige kostenlose Sportaktivitäten auf dem Bachem Campus

jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a dedicated IT Service Delivery Manager (a), 80-100%

Your tasks:

• Own core ITSM processes — Lead Incident, Problem, Configuration and Event Management globally, ensuring SLA compliance and alignment with SOPs/ITIL.

• Define performance metrics — Set KPIs/SLAs, build dashboards, deliver monthly reports and manage escalations

• Maintain process documentation — Create and update SOPs, training materials and ensure role clarity with tracked training records

• Drive Problem Management — Run RCA processes, remediation follow‑up, stakeholder communication and proactive risk identification

• Manage Known Errors — Maintain Key Issue databases and ensure workarounds are documented and shared

• Lead CMDB governance — Own CMDB strategy, CI lifecycle accuracy, data models and service dependency mapping

• Ensure CMDB data quality — Perform audits, reconciliation, issue resolution and integration with change/incident/monitoring processes

• Optimize CMDB tooling — Enhance CMDB/asset platform usage, automate via discovery tools and report on configuration compliance

• Run Event Management — Ensure monitoring coverage, correct event filtering/correlation and impact‑based escalation

• Define event automation — Maintain thresholds, notifications and automated/self‑healing responses

Your profile:

• 7+ years in IT Operations, Service Management or a related technical field, including Service Operations or Service Delivery Management

• Hands-on experience in Incident, Problem, Configuration and/or Event Management; Major Incident Management is an advantage

• ITIL Foundation certification required; ITIL Intermediate/Expert an asset.

• Strong cross-domain technical expertise across infrastructure, applications, databases, and security, with a deep understanding of their interdependencies—including modern workplace devices, application servers, and backend platforms

• Strong analytical skills to identify patterns, correlations and root causes, with the ability to lead technical RCA calls

• Excellent communication skills, translating technical detail into business- and user-friendly language

• Strong facilitation and leadership under pressure, with the ability to work across global teams and manage stakeholders at all levels

• Experience with monitoring, log analysis and service management platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, LogicMonitor).

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Company‑run daycare center on the Bachem Campus in Bubendorf

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Bubendorf!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo professionale
IT Service Delivery Manager (a), 80-100%

Descrizione
Per guidare la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team nell'IT globale, stiamo cercando un IT Service Delivery Manager (a) dedicato, 80-100%.

Le tue attività

- Processi ITSM di base propri — Lead Incident, Problem, Configuration e Event Management a livello globale, garantendo la conformità agli SLA e l'allineamento con SOP/ITIL.
- Definisci le metriche delle prestazioni: imposta KPI/SLA, crea dashboard, fornisci report mensili e gestisci le escalation.
- Mantenere la documentazione di processo — Creare e aggiornare SOP, materiali di formazione e garantire la chiarezza del ruolo con registrazioni di formazione monitorate.
- Guidare la gestione dei problemi — Eseguire i processi RCA, il follow-up delle azioni correttive, la comunicazione con gli stakeholder e l'identificazione proattiva dei rischi.
- Gestisci gli errori noti — Gestisci i database dei problemi chiave e assicurati che le soluzioni siano documentate e condivise.
- Lead CMDB governance — Possiede la strategia CMDB, l'accuratezza del ciclo di vita CI, i modelli di dati e la mappatura delle dipendenze del servizio.
- Garantire la qualità dei dati CMDB — Eseguire audit, riconciliazione, risoluzione dei problemi e integrazione con i processi di modifica/incidente/monitoraggio.
- Ottimizza gli strumenti CMDB — Migliora l'utilizzo della piattaforma CMDB/asset, automatizza tramite strumenti di rilevamento e crea report sulla conformità della configurazione.
- Eseguire la gestione degli eventi — Garantire la copertura del monitoraggio, il corretto filtraggio/correlazione degli eventi e l'escalation basata sull'impatto.
- Definire l'automazione degli eventi — Mantenere soglie, notifiche

- Eigene Kern-ITSM-Prozesse — Lead Incident, Problem, Konfiguration und Event Management weltweit, um die Einhaltung von SLA und die Ausrichtung mit SOPs/ITIL zu gewährleisten. - Definieren Sie Leistungskennzahlen — Setzen Sie KPIs/SLAs, erstellen Sie Dashboards, liefern Sie monatliche Berichte und verwalten Sie Eskalationen. - Pflegen Sie die Prozessdokumentation — Erstellen und aktualisieren Sie SOPs, Schulungsmaterialien und sorgen Sie für Rollenklarheit mit verfolgten Trainingsaufzeichnungen. - Fahren Sie Problemmanagement — Führen Sie RCA-Prozesse, Sanierungs-Follow-up, Stakeholder-Kommunikation und proaktive Risikoidentifikation.

- Les processus de base de la GSTI - Gestion des incidents, des problèmes, de la configuration et des événements à l'échelle mondiale, en assurant la conformité et l'alignement des SLA avec les SOP/TIL. - Définir les paramètres de rendement - Définir les KPI/SLA, construire des tableaux de bord, produire des rapports mensuels et gérer les escalades. - Maintenir la documentation des processus - Créer et mettre à jour les SOP, les documents de formation et assurer la clarté des rôles avec les dossiers de formation suivis. - Gérer les problèmes - Exécuter les processus d'ACR, le suivi de l'assainissement, la communication avec les intervenants et l'identification proactive des risques.

titleByLocale.de: Senior Lab Techniker QC - Late Phase 100% (a)
titleByLocale.fr: Technicien de laboratoire senior QC - Phase tardive 100%

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Für unsere Abteilung QC Late Phase suchen wir aktuell einen engagierten Senior Lab Technician QC mit Fokus HPLC (w/m/d) für eigenständige und präzise analytische Arbeiten in einem spezialisierten Team. Aktuell haben wir eine unbefristete Vakanz, die spannende Einblicke in die späte Phase der Qualitätskontrolle bietet.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Analytische Tätigkeiten: Selbstständige Durchführung von HPLC‑/ U(H)PLC ‑Analysen im Rahmen von Freigabe-, Stabilitäts- und Entwicklungsprojekten. Fachgerechte Vorbereitung, Bedienung und Wartung der Geräte, ggf. inkl. Troubleshooting, um zuverlässige Ergebnisse zu gewährleisten.

• Dokumentation & Auswertung: Sorgfältige Dokumentation aller Arbeitsschritte sowie Auswertung der Rohdaten unter Einhaltung relevanter Qualitätsstandards (GMP).

• Qualitätssicherung & Compliance: Sicherstellung, dass alle Laboraktivitäten den Qualitätsvorgaben und Sicherheitsrichtlinien entsprechen. Bei Qualitätsereignissen (OOX-Fälle) Unterstützung bei der Bearbeitung und Dokumentation.

• Teamarbeit: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit QA, Produktion und weiteren internen Bereichen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Qualitätssicherung im Labor. Gute Kommunikation und präzise Arbeitsweise zur Unterstützung effizienter und reibungsloser Arbeit im Team.

Désignation des marchandises

Pour mener notre croissance organique continue, nous recherchons constamment des spécialistes hautement qualifiés. Pour notre département de la phase tardive de QC, nous recherchons actuellement un technicien de laboratoire senior spécialisé dans la CLHP (p/m/j) pour un travail d'analyse indépendant et précis dans une équipe spécialisée.

Tâches

- Activités analytiques : Mise en oeuvre par des travailleurs indépendants d'analyses HPLC-/ U(H)PLC dans le cadre de projets de libération, de stabilité et de développement. Préparation professionnelle, exploitation et maintenance des appareils, y compris éventuellement dépannage, pour assurer des résultats fiables. - Documentation et évaluation : Documentation attentive de toutes les étapes de travail et évaluation des données brutes en conformité avec les normes de qualité pertinentes (BPF). - Assurance de la qualité et conformité : S'assurer que toutes les activités de laboratoire sont conformes aux spécifications de qualité et aux lignes directrices de sécurité.

En cas d'événements de qualité (cas OOX) Support dans le traitement et la documentation. - Teamwork: Coopération étroite avec l'AQ, la production et d'autres domaines internes pour l'amélioration continue et l'assurance de la qualité dans le laboratoire.

- Une ancienneté bien définie dans le laboratoire de QC : connaissances spécialisées en méthodes de CLHP, compétences élevées en résolution de problèmes et capacité à identifier les risques méthodologiques tôt, à les aborder de manière ciblée et à guider l'équipe dans une exécution sûre et transparente.

Besoins

- Formation professionnelle terminée en tant que laboratoire chimique, de préférence en mettant l'accent sur l'analyse - Connaissances fondées de HPLC/U(H)PLC et expérience en méthodes d'analyse indépendantes; Connaissances LC-MS d'avantage - Expérience professionnelle dans l'industrie pharmaceutique dans l'environnement des BPF - Connaissances dans le domaine des peptides - Compétences de résolution de problèmes - Compétences organisationnelles et financières bien définies - Gestion sécuritaire des systèmes assistés par ordinateur; Expérience éprouvée et A d'efficacité pour LIMS et Chromeleon - Bonne connaissance allemande et anglaise en paroles et en écriture

Nous offrons

- Un environnement de travail dynamique et en croissance rapide avec des possibilités de développement interne - Soutien du personnel par de nombreuses possibilités de formation interne et externe

Als engagierte und motivierte Persönlichkeit sind Sie Teil unserer anspruchsvollen Freigabeanalytik. Es erwarten Sie vielfältige Aufgaben und Fragestellungen in einem dynamischen und spannenden Umfeld. Dabei verantworten Sie im Schwerpunkt die Durchführung von Freigabeanalysen unserer TIDES-Wirkstoffe unter GMP.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Eigenständige Durchführung, Auswertung und Dokumentation von Freigabeanalysen im Bereich Gaschromatographie (GC) und Ionenchromatographie (IC)

• Review und Approval von Freigabeanalysen

• Entwicklung, Validierung und Life Cycle Management von GC und IC Analysemethoden

• Erstellung und Überarbeitung von GMP Dokumenten (z.B. Analysevorschriften, SOP’s)

• Übernahme von Verantwortlichkeiten in der Laborumgebung (u.a. bei der Planung der Routineanalytik, Troubleshooting)

• Pflege der Stammdaten / Logbucheinträge im LIMS

• Unterstützung bei der Analytischen Instrument- und Systemqualifizierung gemäss geltender GMP-Richtlinien und Life Cycle Management der analytischen Geräte

• Aktive Teilnahme an Massnahmen zur Optimierung und Verbesserung von QC-Prozessen

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Chemielaborant/in, Fachrichtung Analytik

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Umfeld chromatographischer GMP-Analytik

• Kenntnisse im Bereich GC/GCMS und IC von Vorteil

• Solide Kenntnisse üblicher IT-Applikationen, z.B. LIMS/LES, CDS (z.B. Chromeleon), SAP, sowie Softwareaffinität

• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste des systèmes CAE (f/m/d), 80-100 %

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Engineering Services suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n CAD / CAE System Spezialisten (w/m/d), 80 – 100%.

In dieser Funktion sind Sie für die Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Betriebs und der Weiterentwicklung unserer AVEVA-Autorentools als Key User und Administrator zuständig, sowie für die Planerstellung im Rahmen von Projekten zum Um- bzw. Neubau von Produktions- oder Infrastrukturanlagen.

Ihre Aufgaben:

AVEVA Super-User / Administration

• Betreuung und Administration der AVEVA-Autorentools (z. B. E3D, Unified Engineering oder vergleichbare Lösungen)

• First- und Second-Level-Support für Anwender

• Einrichtung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Templates, Standards und Datenbanken

• Durchführung von Schulungen und Unterstützung neuer Anwender

• Schnittstellenmanagement zu IT, Engineering und externen Partnern

CAD / CAE

• 3D Aufstellungs- und Rohrleitungsplanung für komplexe Chemie- und Pharmaanlagen.

• Erstellung weiterer Designdokumente, wie z.B. R&I-Schemata, Isometrien, Stücklisten und Halterungszeichnungen

• die räumliche Koordination aller Gewerke, wie z.B. Gebäude, Elektro, EMSR, Lüftung und Reinraum.

• Begleitung der Anlagenrealisierung

• Support bei der Implementierung von BIM

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung z. B. als Konstrukteur/in der Anlagen- oder Gebäudeplanung oder vergleichbar

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Anlagenplanung, Verfahrens- und/ oder Gebäudetechnik (bevorzugt im chemisch- / pharmazeutischen Umfeld)

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in AVEVA CAD/CAE-Tools, Erfahrung in der Rolle als Key User, CAD-Administrator oder Super-User von Vorteil

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der CAD-Konstruktion (2D/3D)

• Hohe Belastbarkeit und ein Faible für die digitale Planung

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
